catalog.title: 兩奈米以下製程架構

catalog.summaryEn: Study nanosheet devices, contacts and backside power delivery. A process-node name is not the physical size of every feature.

catalog.title: ASML 微影機系統工程
catalog.summary: 拆解光源、光學、精密平台、真空與量測的共同設計，深入理解 DUV 透鏡與 EUV 反射鏡為何不同。以公開原理建立原創示意模型。
catalog.summaryEn: Explore the co-design of source, optics, precision stages, vacuum and metrology, including why DUV lenses and EUV mirrors differ. Build an original schematic from public principles.

catalog.title: 經國號與航空製造概念

catalog.summaryEn: Use the IDF development history to study general aircraft structures, material traceability, integration and verification management.

catalog.title: 阿帕契案例與旋翼機原理

catalog.title: 國造潛艦案例與水下載具工程

catalog.summaryEn: Study underwater vehicles through buoyancy, pressure and life safety using civilian research-submersible sources and unpressurized desktop models.

catalog.title: 淡江大橋工程

catalog.summaryEn: Study load paths, construction stages, durability and monitoring through a single-pylon asymmetric cable-stayed bridge.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統

catalog.title: 雪山隧道工程

catalog.summaryEn: Learn how complex geology, groundwater, excavation support and operational safety shape long tunnels.

catalog.title: 防禦性資訊安全網路

catalog.title: 先進封裝共同設計

catalog.summaryEn: Twenty modules and 520 progress-preserving educational operations connect incoming inspection, thinning, dicing, bonding, fan-out, RDL, TSVs, HBM, cooling and CPO verification; 40 selected operations add quantitative examples, model boundaries and diagnostics.

catalog.title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎
catalog.titleEn: Silicon Photonics and CPO Optical Engines
catalog.summary: 48 項循序任務：由波導、光源與調變器進入光纖封裝、IL/PDL、熱串擾矩陣、應力相位、製程公差、N−1 備援與端到端 BER 驗收，含可手算的自訂工程案例。

catalog.summary: 以 13.5 nm 雷射電漿（LPP）錫滴光源為對象，從錫離子的 4d–4f 發射帶與 CO₂ 雷射的臨界密度出發，建立從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈，再拆解錫滴產生器、前脈衝與主脈衝、錫滴偵測與雷射導向、劑量統計、氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔，最後以可用度與反射率衰減記錄完成驗收。本課為教學模型，不含任何操作程序。
catalog.summaryEn: Taking the 13.5 nm laser-produced-plasma tin-droplet source as the object, the course starts from the 4d–4f emission band of tin ions and the critical density of CO₂ laser light, builds the power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus, then works through the droplet generator, pre-pulse and main pulse, droplet detection and laser steering, dose statistics, hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning, and closes with an availability and reflectance-decay acceptance record. It is a teaching model and contains no operating procedure.

catalog.title: 微影晶圓台精密定位
catalog.titleEn: Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages
catalog.summary: 以步進掃描微影機的雙台晶圓台為對象：先建立光罩台與晶圓台 4:1 同步掃描的 MA/MSD 誤差定義與 Abbe 原理，再拆解長短行程 Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量、雷射干涉儀與二維光柵編碼器的解析度與空氣折射率限制，接著以伺服頻寬、前饋精度、校正圖與隔振傳遞率建立奈米級誤差預算，最後整合成產能與套刻驗收記錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Taking the dual wafer stage of a step-and-scan lithography system as the object, the course first defines the MA/MSD errors of 4:1 synchronised reticle and wafer scanning and the Abbe principle, then dissects long- and short-stroke Lorentz actuators with balance masses, the resolution and air-index limits of laser interferometers and two-dimensional grating encoders, builds a nanometre error budget from servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy, calibration maps and isolation transmissibility, and closes with a throughput and overlay acceptance record.

catalog.title: 消色差透鏡設計
catalog.summary: 用玻璃色散、光焦度分配與成像驗證，理解雙合透鏡如何降低色差，以及仍須處理的像差與公差。
catalog.summaryEn: Use glass dispersion, optical-power allocation and imaging checks to understand chromatic correction and its remaining aberrations and tolerances.

catalog.title: 複消色差顯微物鏡
catalog.summary: 以 100×/1.4 油浸複消色差物鏡為對象：從 Abbe 解析度與軸向景深建立規格邊界，推導二級光譜如何由玻璃的部分色散差決定、為何需要螢石類異常色散材料，說明齊明半球前鏡組如何把 NA 1.4 的光線角逐級降低，再談鏡片偏心與增透膜、蓋玻片厚度球差與校正環，最後以多波長 PSF 量測與 Strehl 預算完成驗收。
catalog.summaryEn: Taking a 100×/1.4 oil-immersion apochromat as the object, the course sets the specification boundary from Abbe resolution and axial depth of field, derives how secondary spectrum is fixed by the partial-dispersion difference of the glasses and why fluorite-type anomalous-dispersion materials are needed, explains how the aplanatic hemispherical front group steps the NA 1.4 ray angles down, covers element decentration, antireflection coatings, cover-glass spherical aberration and the correction collar, and closes acceptance with multi-wavelength PSF measurement and a Strehl budget.

catalog.title: 非球面光學加工
catalog.summary: 以一片半徑 50 mm、口徑 50 mm 的拋物面為貫穿案例：先用矢高方程算出它與球面的偏離量與斜率，說明為何無法用標準球面工法與干涉儀直接處理，再拆解 CNC 研磨、磁流變等確定性次口徑拋光的去除率與收斂、單點鑽石車削的理論粗糙度與精密玻璃模造的收縮補償，接著以輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接量測建立誤差預算，最後以對心公差、熱穩定性與 ISO 10110 圖面完成驗收交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Using a paraboloid of 50 mm radius and 50 mm aperture as the running case, the course first computes its departure from a sphere and its slope with the sag equation to show why standard spherical methods and interferometers cannot handle it directly, then dissects CNC grinding, the removal rate and convergence of deterministic subaperture polishing such as MRF, the theoretical roughness of single-point diamond turning and the shrinkage compensation of precision glass molding, builds an error budget from profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching, and finishes with centring tolerances, thermal stability and ISO 10110 drawing-based acceptance.

catalog.title: 自由曲面光學量測
catalog.summary: 以一片口徑 50 mm、對最佳擬合球面偏離 200 µm、最大斜率 20 mrad 的自由曲面反射鏡為案例：先說明無對稱軸的表面為何讓六個剛體自由度與面形誤差糾纏，必須靠基準與定位標記配準；再比較 CGH 零位干涉、傾斜波非零位干涉、接觸與光學探針輪廓儀及次口徑拼接的物理限制，建立含 CGH 寫入誤差、基板、回溯誤差與熱漂移的不確定度預算，最後以兩種獨立方法交叉驗證並把量測圖回饋到確定性修形與實測重最佳化。
catalog.summaryEn: Using a 50 mm freeform mirror with 200 µm departure from its best-fit sphere and 20 mrad maximum slope as the case, the course first shows why a surface without a symmetry axis entangles the six rigid-body degrees of freedom with form error and must be registered through datums and fiducials; it then compares the physical limits of CGH null interferometry, tilted-wave non-null interferometry, contact and optical probe profilometry and subaperture stitching, builds an uncertainty budget covering CGH writing error, substrate, retrace error and thermal drift, and closes by cross-validating two independent methods and feeding the map back into deterministic figuring and as-built re-optimisation.

catalog.title: 光學玻璃精密退火
catalog.summary: 以一塊厚 100 mm 的 N-BK7 光學玻璃毛胚為案例：從黏度與 Maxwell 鬆弛時間說明退火點與應變點的意義，推導冷卻速率如何透過假想溫度改變折射率、毛胚內溫差如何依 Adams–Williamson 關係凍結成殘餘應力，再談精密退火爐的均勻性要求、應力雙折射與折射率均勻性的量測，最後設計一份完整的退火程式並以熔次資料表完成與光學設計的交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Using a 100 mm thick N-BK7 blank as the case, the course explains the annealing and strain points through viscosity and the Maxwell relaxation time, derives how cooling rate changes refractive index via the fictive temperature and how the temperature difference inside the blank freezes into residual stress by the Adams–Williamson relation, then covers the uniformity demands on a precision annealing furnace, the measurement of stress birefringence and index homogeneity, and finally designs a complete annealing schedule and hands the melt data sheet over to optical design.

catalog.title: 離子束光學表面修形
catalog.summary: 從氬離子濺射的原子級去除出發，建立高斯去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與空間頻率上限的概念，再把離子源、柵極、真空與基板熱負載、干涉量測對位、誤差預算與驗收紀錄串成一條可重複的確定性修形流程。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from atomic-scale removal by argon-ion sputtering, build the Gaussian removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and spatial-frequency limit, then chain ion source, grids, vacuum, substrate thermal load, interferometer registration, error budget and acceptance record into a repeatable deterministic figuring process.

catalog.title: 磁流變光學拋光
catalog.summary: 從羰基鐵粒子在磁場中成鏈、形成具降伏應力的流體帶談起，用 Preston 關係與 D 形去除點建立磁流變拋光的去除模型，再把拋光輪、流體黏度閉迴路、工件材料與次表面損傷、干涉量測與去除點校正、誤差預算，直到清洗與驗收交接，整合成一條可重複的非球面修形流程。
catalog.summaryEn: Start with carbonyl-iron particles chaining in a magnetic field into a ribbon with a yield stress, model removal with the Preston relation and the D-shaped spot, then integrate the wheel, fluid-viscosity loop, workpiece materials and subsurface damage, interferometry and spot calibration, error budget, cleaning and acceptance into a repeatable aspheric figuring process.

catalog.title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 薄膜、繞射與微結構光學元件
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Coatings, diffractive and structured optical elements
catalog.summary: 從單層膜的 Fresnel 振幅相加出發，用特徵矩陣與導納轉換推導四分之一波堆的反射率與阻帶寬度，再討論氧化物與氟化物材料、蒸鍍與濺鍍的微結構差異、石英晶體與光學監控、分光光度驗證與逆向工程、入射角與環境造成的光譜位移，直到均勻性夾具、環境測試與驗收交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Beginning with Fresnel amplitudes adding in a single film, derive quarter-wave-stack reflectance and stop-band width with the characteristic matrix and admittance transformation, then cover oxide and fluoride materials, the microstructural difference between evaporated and sputtered films, quartz-crystal and optical monitoring, spectrophotometric verification and reverse engineering, spectral shifts with incidence angle and environment, and finally uniformity fixtures, environmental testing and acceptance handoff.

catalog.title: 增透膜設計與沉積
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 薄膜、繞射與微結構光學元件
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Coatings, diffractive and structured optical elements
catalog.summary: 從 Fresnel 反射與多片鏡頭的穿透率損失出發，用導納匹配條件推導 MgF₂ 單層、四分之一波雙層 V 膜與四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜的殘餘反射率，再討論低折射率膜材與熱基板蒸鍍、透鏡上的厚度分佈、低反射率量測的背面陷阱、入射角與偏振的影響，最後把殘餘反射換算成鏡頭鬼影與穿透率預算並完成驗收交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from Fresnel reflection and the transmission loss of multi-element lenses, derive the residual reflectance of a MgF₂ single layer, a quarter-quarter V-coat and a quarter-half-quarter broadband design from the admittance-matching condition, then cover low-index materials and hot-substrate evaporation, thickness distribution on lenses, the back-surface trap in low-reflectance metrology, incidence-angle and polarization effects, and finally convert residual reflectance into lens ghost and transmission budgets for acceptance handoff.

catalog.subcategoryTitle: 薄膜、繞射與微結構光學元件
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Coatings, diffractive and structured optical elements
catalog.summary: 雷射鏡片與一般高反射膜的差別在於損耗以 ppm 計、功率以損傷門檻計：本課從 1 − R = T + A + S 的損耗帳出發，分析四分之一波堆內的駐波場與損傷起點、超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷、離子束濺鍍與退火對吸收的要求，再用光腔衰盪、光熱吸收與 ISO 21254 損傷測試驗證，最後處理高功率熱效應、安裝污染與規格交接。
catalog.summaryEn: A laser mirror differs from an ordinary high reflector in that loss is counted in ppm and power in damage threshold: starting from the loss ledger 1 − R = T + A + S, the course analyses the standing-wave field and damage origin inside a quarter-wave stack, superpolished substrates and nodular defects, ion-beam sputtering and annealing requirements for absorption, then verifies with cavity ring-down, photothermal absorption and ISO 21254 damage testing, and finishes with high-power thermal effects, mounting contamination and specification handoff.

catalog.subcategoryTitle: 薄膜、繞射與微結構光學元件

catalog.summary: 本課以消光比與延遲量兩個核心指標貫穿偏振元件的製作：先用 Malus 定律與雙折射建立規格的物理意義，再分別處理石英波片的定向、研磨至延遲量與零級複合結構、方解石 Glan 稜鏡的全反射幾何、奈米線柵與 MacNeille 薄膜偏振分光器、Fresnel 菱體的消色差延遲，接著用 Sénarmont 與消光比量測建立誤差預算，最後處理應力雙折射安裝與規格交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Two figures of merit, extinction ratio and retardance, run through this course on fabricating polarization optics: Malus's law and birefringence give the specifications physical meaning, then quartz-waveplate orientation, polishing to retardance and compound zero-order construction, the total-internal-reflection geometry of calcite Glan prisms, nanowire-grid and MacNeille thin-film beam splitters and the achromatic retardance of the Fresnel rhomb are treated in turn, followed by Sénarmont and extinction-ratio metrology for the error budget, stress-birefringence-free mounting and specification handoff.

catalog.summary: 以 8 µm 像素、1920×1200 的反射式 LCOS 相位調制器為對象，從向列型液晶的雙折射推導 2π 相位行程與單元間隙的關係，計算像素化閃耀光柵的繞射效率與最大偏折角，再把液晶響應時間、相位閃爍、溫度漂移與背板平整度整合成查找表校正與波前修正流程，最後以傅立葉光學系統的驗收指標完成交接。

catalog.summary: 以 0.65 吋 1080p、7.56 µm 間距、±12° 傾角的數位微鏡元件為核心，推導照明 f 數與傾角的關係、微鏡陣列的繞射級位置與光展量上限，說明積分柱、TIR 稜鏡與投影鏡頭的設計規則，再以亮度鏈、對比、均勻度與圖樣時序的量測完成光學引擎的誤差預算與交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Built around a 0.65-inch 1080p digital micromirror device with 7.56 µm pitch and ±12° tilt, the course derives the illumination f-number from tilt angle, the diffraction-order positions and étendue ceiling of the mirror array, states the design rules of integrator rods, TIR prisms and projection lenses, and closes the engine's error budget and handoff through measurements of the luminous-flux chain, contrast, uniformity and pattern timing.

catalog.title: 相位式計算全像
catalog.summary: 以 1920×1080、8 µm 像素的相位型 SLM 與 300 mm 傅立葉透鏡為基準系統，說明重建面取樣與視窗大小的關係、Gerchberg–Saxton 演算法的收斂與計算成本、相位量化與像素包絡的效率損失，再以相機閉環校正、散斑與零階的誤差預算，以及近眼全像顯示的視角與眼盒限制，完成相位全像的設計到驗收流程。
catalog.summaryEn: Using a 1920×1080, 8 µm phase-only SLM with a 300 mm Fourier lens as the reference system, the course explains replay-plane sampling and window size, the convergence and compute cost of the Gerchberg–Saxton algorithm, efficiency losses from phase quantization and the pixel envelope, then camera-in-the-loop calibration, a speckle and zeroth-order error budget and the field-of-view and eyebox limits of near-eye holographic displays, completing the design-to-acceptance flow of phase-only holograms.

catalog.summaryEn: Start from the off-axis interference fringes that object and reference beams form on the sensor, see how the carrier frequency lets a single hologram yield the complex wavefront, then integrate phase unwrapping, source coherence, objective-curvature compensation, refractive-index and wavelength calibration, noise budgets and numerical refocusing into an acceptable quantitative-phase microscope.

catalog.summaryEn: Derive the axial resolution of OCT from the coherence length of a broadband source, see how Fourier-domain detection encodes depth as spectral interference frequency and why spectrometer pixel spacing sets depth range and sensitivity roll-off, then integrate source bandwidth, spectrometer dispersion, the shot-noise limit, arm dispersion matching and scanning optics into an acceptable tomographic imaging system.

catalog.summary: 以 1 km 線圈的干涉式光纖陀螺儀為對象，從薩格納克相位 Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc) 與最小互易架構出發，建置寬頻光源、鈮酸鋰積體光學晶片、保偏光纖四極線圈與本徵頻率偏壓調制，再用轉台校正、艾倫偏差分離角度隨機漫步與零偏不穩定性，並以閉迴路鋸齒波回授與 IEEE 952 式測試完成導航級陀螺的驗收。
catalog.summaryEn: Taking a 1 km coil interferometric fiber-optic gyroscope as the object, this course starts from the Sagnac phase Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc) and the minimum reciprocal configuration, builds the broadband source, lithium-niobate integrated-optic chip, quadrupole-wound polarization-maintaining coil and proper-frequency bias modulation, then separates angle random walk from bias instability with rate-table calibration and Allan deviation, and closes with closed-loop serrodyne feedback and IEEE 952-style tests for navigation-grade acceptance.

catalog.summary: 以一台 DN100、約 260 L/s 的混合軸承渦輪分子泵與它的泵站為對象：從分子流下葉片把動量傳給氣體分子出發，理解壓縮比為何隨分子量呈指數變化、前級壓力如何決定極限壓力；再把轉子材料與動平衡、電容薄膜計、Pirani、Penning 與 Bayard–Alpert 真空計的物理與校正鏈、抽速量測與互鎖整合成可驗收的真空泵站。
catalog.summaryEn: Built around a DN100, roughly 260 L/s hybrid-bearing turbomolecular pump and its pumping station: start from blades handing momentum to gas molecules in molecular flow to see why the compression ratio grows exponentially with molecular mass and how foreline pressure sets the ultimate pressure, then integrate rotor materials and balancing, the physics and calibration chain of capacitance-diaphragm, Pirani, Penning and Bayard–Alpert gauges, pumping-speed measurement and interlocks into a pumping station that can be accepted.

catalog.summaryEn: Follow a 1000 kg honeycomb optical table on four 1.5 Hz pneumatic legs to see how a floor VC class becomes nanometre tabletop motion through transmissibility, then integrate table modes, the tilt limit of active isolation, thermal and acoustic drift and vibration short circuits through hoses into a measurable, transferable platform acceptance record.

catalog.title: 同步輻射儲存環
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
catalog.summary: 以一座 3 GeV、528 m 的教學用多彎消色散儲存環為主線，從同步輻射造成的每圈 430 keV 能量損失出發，說明發射度為何隨彎轉角三次方下降，再把小孔徑磁鐵、射頻補能、束流尺寸量測、Touschek 壽命、插件磁鐵擾動與頂注驗收整合成可交接的光源工程紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Follow a 3 GeV, 528 m teaching multi-bend-achromat storage ring from the 430 keV per-turn energy loss caused by synchrotron radiation, see why emittance falls with the cube of the bending angle, then integrate small-bore magnets, RF energy replacement, beam-size measurement, Touschek lifetime, insertion-device perturbations and top-up acceptance into a transferable light-source engineering record.

catalog.title: 自由電子雷射加速器
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
catalog.summary: 以一座教學用 5.8 GeV、C 波段精簡型硬 X 光 FEL 為主線，從共振條件如何決定加速器長度出發，說明電子槍、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器如何產生 3 kA 的高品質束團，再把飛秒級縱向診斷、射頻抖動預算、波盪器軌道直線度與增益曲線驗收整合成可交接的 FEL 加速器工程紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Follow a 5.8 GeV, C-band compact hard X-ray FEL used for teaching, starting from how the resonance condition sets linac length, see how the gun, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes produce a high-quality 3 kA bunch, then integrate femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics, the RF jitter budget, undulator trajectory straightness and gain-curve acceptance into a transferable FEL-accelerator engineering record.

catalog.title: 粒子加速器射頻腔
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
catalog.summary: 以 500 MHz 級常溫銅射頻腔為主軸，從 TM010 模態與渡越時間因子推到銅壁損耗、分路阻抗與冷卻，再把輸入耦合器 β、網路分析儀與珠拉量測、熱失諧調諧、束流負載補償及速調管與低階射頻迴路整合成可交接的加速腔工程紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Built around a 500 MHz-class normal-conducting copper cavity, the course goes from the TM010 mode and transit-time factor to copper wall loss, shunt impedance and cooling, then integrates the input-coupler β, network-analyser and bead-pull measurements, thermal-detuning tuning, beam-loading compensation and the klystron plus LLRF loop into a transferable cavity engineering record.

catalog.summary: 以 TESLA 型 1.3 GHz 九腔鈮製超導加速腔為對象，從 BCS 表面電阻與 Q₀ = G/Rs 出發，走過高 RRR 鈮板、深拉與電子束焊、電解拋光與烘烤、2 K 垂直測試與頻率調諧，最後整合成低溫模組並交付驗收紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Using the TESLA-type 1.3 GHz nine-cell niobium cavity, start from BCS surface resistance and Q₀ = G/Rs, then follow high-RRR niobium sheet, deep drawing and electron-beam welding, electropolishing and baking, 2 K vertical testing and frequency tuning, and end with cryomodule integration and an acceptance record.

catalog.summary: 以插件磁鐵光束線上的液氮冷卻 Si(111) 雙晶單色器為對象，從布拉格條件與動力學繞射的 Darwin 寬度推導能量解析度，再處理數百瓦熱負載下的晶體變形、固定出口機構、吸收邊能量校正、穩定度預算與高次諧波抑制，最後交付一份可重現的試運轉紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Taking the liquid-nitrogen-cooled Si(111) double-crystal monochromator of an insertion-device beamline, derive energy resolution from the Bragg condition and the dynamical-diffraction Darwin width, then handle crystal distortion under hundreds of watts, the fixed-exit mechanism, absorption-edge energy calibration, the stability budget and harmonic rejection, ending with a reproducible commissioning record.

catalog.title: 高亮度 X 光束線
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
catalog.summary: 以 3 GeV 儲存環上的波盪器硬 X 光束線為例，說明光束線為何只能保存而不能增加亮度，並把掠射全反射鏡、前端熱負載、鏡面斜率誤差與量測、光束位置穩定度、Kirkpatrick–Baez 聚焦與通量校正串成一份可驗收的光束線工程紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Using an undulator hard X-ray beamline on a 3 GeV storage ring, the course shows why a beamline can only preserve and never increase brilliance, then links grazing-incidence mirrors, front-end heat load, mirror slope error and its metrology, beam-position stability, Kirkpatrick–Baez focusing and flux calibration into an acceptance-ready beamline engineering record.

catalog.title: 中子散射儀
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
catalog.summary: 從中子的德布羅意波長與毫電子伏特能量出發，說明反應爐與散裂源如何經緩速器產生熱與冷中子，再把超鏡導管、斬波器飛行時間、三軸譜儀的單色器與分析器、³He 偵測器效率、釩標準歸一化與背景計數統計整合成一份可驗收的中子散射儀工程紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the de Broglie wavelength and millielectronvolt energy of neutrons, the course shows how reactors and spallation sources produce thermal and cold neutrons through moderators, then integrates supermirror guides, chopper time of flight, triple-axis monochromators and analysers, ³He detector efficiency, vanadium normalisation and background counting statistics into an acceptance-ready neutron-scattering instrument record.

catalog.title: 閃爍體粒子偵測器
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
catalog.summary: 以 NaI(Tl)、LYSO 晶體與 EJ-200 塑膠閃爍體為例，追蹤一個 662 keV 伽瑪光子如何變成數萬個閃爍光子、數千個光電子與一個可校正的脈衝，並把 Birks 淬滅、光學耦合與反射層、PMT 與 SiPM、能量解析度分解、溫度增益漂移與符合計時整合成可交接的偵測器工程紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Using NaI(Tl), LYSO crystals and EJ-200 plastic, the course follows a 662 keV gamma ray as it becomes tens of thousands of scintillation photons, thousands of photoelectrons and one calibratable pulse, then integrates Birks quenching, optical coupling and reflectors, PMTs and SiPMs, energy-resolution decomposition, temperature-driven gain drift and coincidence timing into a transferable detector engineering record.

catalog.title: 矽像素粒子追蹤器
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
catalog.summary: 以 CMS 與 ALICE 的像素追蹤器為參照，從最小游離粒子在 285 µm 矽中釋放約兩萬兩千個電子出發，把空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、混合式與 MAPS 架構、輻射損傷、位置解析度、物質量、觸發緩衝與軌跡式對準串成一份可驗收、可交接的追蹤器工程紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Using the CMS and ALICE pixel trackers as references, start from the roughly 22,000 electrons a minimum-ionising particle frees in 285 µm of silicon, then connect depletion and Lorentz drift, hybrid versus MAPS architectures, radiation damage, spatial resolution, material budget, trigger buffering and track-based alignment into an acceptable, transferable tracker engineering record.

catalog.title: 時間投影室偵測器
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器

catalog.summaryEn: Using the 90 m³ ALICE TPC at CERN as the template: from electron drift and diffusion at 400 V/cm, through gain and ion back-flow of four-GEM readout, to laser and krypton calibration, space-charge distortion maps and continuous readout of 524,160 channels, integrated into a transferable detector performance record.

catalog.title: 低雜訊偵測器讀出
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
catalog.summary: 以矽微條與 HPGe 前端為例，從 Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏積分出發，推導 ENC 的串聯、並聯與 1/f 項如何隨電容與整形時間變化，再把脈衝校正、能量解析度分解、ASIC 數位化與門檻佔用率整合成可交接的讀出系統驗證紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Using silicon-strip and HPGe front ends as examples, start from Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive integration, derive how the series, parallel and 1/f terms of ENC scale with capacitance and shaping time, then integrate pulse calibration, resolution decomposition, ASIC digitisation and threshold occupancy into a transferable readout-validation record.

catalog.summaryEn: Using the ESO VLT Adaptive Optics Facility with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and the 2.4 m, 5000-plus-actuator M4 of the ELT as templates: derive deformable-mirror and wavefront-sensor specifications from r0, the Greenwood frequency and the isoplanatic angle, assemble fitting, temporal, measurement and non-common-path terms into a Strehl budget, and close with real-time control dynamics and on-sky validation for engineering handoff.

catalog.titleEn: Active support of telescope primary mirrors

catalog.summary: 以 VLT 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡與 150 支軸向致動器為主軸，理解為什麼薄鏡必須由力分佈定義面形，再把彎曲模態、仰角載重、溫度梯度、30 秒積分的 Shack–Hartmann 感測、查找表與力圖健康監測整合成可驗收的主動光學工程。
catalog.summaryEn: Built around the VLT's 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus and its 150 axial actuators, this course shows why a thin mirror's figure must be defined by its force distribution, then integrates bending modes, elevation loads, thermal gradients, 30-second Shack–Hartmann sensing, look-up tables and force-map health monitoring into an acceptable active-optics engineering record.

catalog.title: 分段鏡共相控制
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 天文儀器與科學感測器
catalog.summary: 以 Keck 10 m 主鏡的 36 片段鏡、108 支致動器與 168 個邊緣感測器為主軸，並對照 ELT 的 798 片段鏡，理解如何把數十片獨立鏡面維持在同一個波前上：從 piston 誤差與 Strehl、可觀測性、感測器漂移、寬頻與雙波長共相，到控制迴路與段鏡更換後的重新共相。
catalog.summaryEn: Built around the Keck 10 m primary with 36 segments, 108 actuators and 168 edge sensors, and compared with the ELT's 798 segments, this course shows how dozens of separate mirrors are held on one wavefront: from piston error and Strehl, observability and sensor drift, to broadband and dual-wavelength phasing, control loops and re-phasing after segment exchange.

catalog.summary: 從 European XFEL 的 3.4 km 超導直線加速器與每秒 10 列、每列最多 2700 發的突發模式出發，理解射頻脈衝預算、波盪器共振與段間相位、2 K 低溫負載、掠射反射鏡面形、AGIPD 記憶格校正、束團分配與機器保護如何串成一座可交接的硬 X 光雷射設施。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the 3.4 km superconducting linac of European XFEL and its burst mode of 10 trains per second with up to 2700 pulses each, see how the RF pulse budget, undulator resonance and inter-segment phase, 2 K cryogenic load, grazing-mirror figure, AGIPD memory-cell calibration, bunch distribution and machine protection combine into a hard X-ray laser facility that can be handed over.

catalog.summaryEn: Using ESO's NTT, commissioned in 1989, this course explains why a 3.58 m Zerodur meniscus only 24 cm thick must rely on 75 active axial supports and an off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann analyser to hold its figure, how the octagonal rotating enclosure and mirror temperature control suppress local seeing, and how optics, tracking, mirror seeing and atmospheric seeing combine into an acceptable image-quality budget.

catalog.title: LIGO 重力波觀測站
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 大型望遠鏡與重力波觀測站
catalog.summary: 以漢福德與利文斯頓兩座 4 km 的 Advanced LIGO 干涉儀為對象，從應變 h = ΔL/L 與 1064 nm 雷射的相位讀出出發，推導臂腔精細度、循環功率、鍍膜熱雜訊、四重擺隔振、散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光的效果，再以光子校正器、雜訊預算、鎖定流程與觀測運行交接把 10⁻²³/√Hz 等級的靈敏度做成可驗證的工程。
catalog.summaryEn: Using the two 4 km Advanced LIGO interferometers at Hanford and Livingston, this course starts from strain h = ΔL/L and phase readout with a 1064 nm laser, derives arm-cavity finesse, recycled power, coating thermal noise, quadruple-pendulum isolation, the shot-noise amplitude spectral density and the gain from squeezed light, then turns a sensitivity of order 10⁻²³/√Hz into verifiable engineering through photon calibrators, noise budgets, lock acquisition and observing-run handoff.

catalog.title: Virgo 重力波干涉儀
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 大型望遠鏡與重力波觀測站
catalog.summary: 以義大利卡希納 EGO 的 Advanced Virgo 為對象，從 3 km 臂腔的自由光譜範圍與線寬出發，解析卡希納近海站址的地震雜訊為何需要約 9 m 高、以倒立擺預隔離的超級衰減器，42 kg 熔融石英鏡的熱透鏡如何用 CO₂ 雷射補償，牛頓雜訊、牛頓校正器與 1.2 m 真空管殘氣如何進入靈敏度預算，以及三站網路的天區定位與運行交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Using Advanced Virgo at EGO in Cascina, Italy, this course starts from the free spectral range and linewidth of 3 km arm cavities, explains why the seismic noise of the near-coastal Cascina site demands a superattenuator about 9 m tall with inverted-pendulum pre-isolation, how the thermal lens in 42 kg fused-silica mirrors is compensated with CO₂ lasers, how Newtonian noise, the Newtonian calibrator and residual gas in the 1.2 m vacuum tubes enter the sensitivity budget, and how three-detector sky localisation and run handoff are organised.

catalog.title: KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 大型望遠鏡與重力波觀測站
catalog.summary: 以神岡礦山地下超過 200 m 的 KAGRA 為對象，理解它如何用地底低地動與把 22.8 kg 藍寶石測試質量冷到約 20 K 兩個策略壓低雜訊，再把 3 km Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與訊號擷取、藍寶石光學、低溫懸吊導熱、熱連結振動、網路觀測與冷凝污染整合成可交接的觀測站工程。
catalog.summaryEn: Taking KAGRA, more than 200 m underground in the Kamioka mine, see how it lowers noise with two strategies, a quiet underground site and 22.8 kg sapphire test masses cooled to about 20 K, then integrate 3 km Fabry–Pérot arms with signal extraction, sapphire optics, cryogenic heat extraction, heat-link vibration, network observing and cryo-contamination into a transferable observatory engineering record.

catalog.title: 金門大橋（金門）
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
catalog.summary: 金門大橋跨越金烈水道連接大金門與小金門，全長約 5.4 公里，主橋為五塔六跨預力箱梁脊背橋，最大跨徑 200 公尺。本課從海況與荷載出發，拆解脊背索的受力分工、花崗片麻岩中的大口徑基樁、鋼箱圍堰樁帽、興達港預鑄節塊的海運與懸臂吊裝、索力量測與載重試驗，最後談海洋耐久與營運交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Kinmen Bridge crosses the Kinmen–Lieyu channel between Greater and Lesser Kinmen; the route is about 5.4 km long and the main bridge is a five-tower, six-span prestressed box-girder extradosed bridge with a longest span of 200 m. Starting from sea conditions and loads, the course unpacks how extradosed stays share load, large-diameter piles in granitic gneiss, steel box cofferdam pile caps, sea transport and cantilever erection of segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour, stay-force measurement and load testing, and finally marine durability and operational handover.

catalog.title: 1915 恰納卡萊大橋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 懸索橋巨作與主纜系統
catalog.summary: 1915 恰納卡萊大橋以 2,023 m 主跨橫跨達達尼爾海峽，2022 年通車，鋼塔高 318 m。本課從垂跨比與塔高的取捨出發，計算 1,960 MPa 級平行鋼絲主纜的斷面，說明在地震帶海床上以乾塢預製、拖航沉放的沉箱作為隔震式基礎，再處理索鞍預偏、87 個橋面節塊吊裝、雙箱梁風洞試驗、吊索力量測、鋼橋面疲勞與伸縮縫交接。
catalog.summaryEn: The 1915 Çanakkale Bridge crosses the Dardanelles with a 2,023 m main span and 318 m steel towers, opening in 2022. The course starts from the trade-off between sag ratio and tower height, sizes a parallel-wire cable of 1,960 MPa class wire, explains caissons built in dry dock, towed and set on a seismic seabed as an isolated foundation, then covers saddle presetting, lifting 87 deck blocks, twin-box wind-tunnel testing, hanger-force measurement, steel-deck fatigue and expansion-joint handover.

catalog.title: 米約高架橋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
catalog.summary: 米約高架橋以七座混凝土高墩、七座鋼塔與 2,460 公尺連續鋼箱梁跨越法國塔恩河谷，最高墩約 245 公尺、塔頂高 343 公尺。本課從河谷高空風與多跨斜張體系的勁度問題出發，分析雙肢橋墩、正交異性鋼箱梁與 154 根單股斜索，再拆解由兩岸頂推、經臨時鋼墩把跨徑減半的施工法與合龍，最後談斜索監測、載重試驗、鋼橋面疲勞與特許經營期的維護。
catalog.summaryEn: The Millau Viaduct crosses the Tarn valley in France on seven concrete piers, seven steel pylons and a 2,460 m continuous steel box deck, with the tallest pier about 245 m and the pylon tops at 343 m. The course starts with high-level valley wind and the stiffness problem of multi-span cable-stayed bridges, examines split-shaft piers, the orthotropic steel box and 154 monostrand stays, then unpacks launching from both abutments over temporary towers that halve the spans and the closure, ending with stay monitoring, load testing, deck fatigue and maintenance through the concession.

catalog.title: 厄勒海峽大橋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
catalog.summary: 厄勒海峽大橋是連接丹麥與瑞典固定通道的橋梁段，全長約 7,845 公尺，主跨 490 公尺的斜張高橋與兩側 140 公尺跨的引橋都採用上層公路、下層鐵路的鋼—混凝土複合桁架。本課從海峽零阻水要求、雙層桁架與豎琴式斜索的荷載路徑出發，拆解石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱、204 公尺混凝土橋塔、Svanen 浮吊整跨吊裝與主跨合龍，再談鐵路制動力、船撞風險、疲勞防蝕與鋼軌伸縮調節器的交接。
catalog.summaryEn: The Øresund Bridge is the bridge section of the fixed link between Denmark and Sweden: about 7,845 m long, with a cable-stayed high bridge of 490 m main span and approach viaducts of 140 m spans, all built as steel–concrete composite trusses carrying a motorway above and a railway below. The course starts from the strait's zero-blocking requirement and the load path through double-deck trusses and harp stays, then covers precast caissons on limestone, the 204 m concrete pylons, full-span lifts by the floating crane Svanen and main-span closure, ending with rail braking, ship-impact risk, fatigue and corrosion, and the handover of rail expansion devices.

catalog.title: 青馬大橋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 懸索橋巨作與主纜系統
catalog.summary: 青馬大橋主跨 1,377 m，1997 年通車，上層六線公路、下層兩條鐵路軌道與兩條有遮蔽的車道，是承載鐵路的最長跨徑懸索橋。本課從鐵路對橋面坡度與變位的要求、颱風下的行車安全出發，計算空中紡線主纜的主跨與邊跨鋼絲數差異，說明滑模混凝土塔、96 個橋面模組吊裝、伸縮縫與軌道銜接，再以香港路政署的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS）、交通量與水上淨空管制，說明營運維護。
catalog.summaryEn: Tsing Ma Bridge has a 1,377 m main span and opened in 1997, carrying six road lanes above and two rail tracks plus two sheltered carriageways below, the longest-span suspension bridge carrying rail. The course starts from rail demands on deck gradient and deflection and from vehicle safety in typhoons, derives the difference in wire count between main and side spans of the air-spun cables, explains slipformed concrete towers, lifting 96 deck modules, expansion joints and track continuity, then uses the Highways Department's Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS), traffic data and marine air-draft control to explain operation and maintenance.

catalog.title: 昂船洲大橋
catalog.summary: 昂船洲大橋以 1,018 m 主跨橫越香港藍巴勒海峽，主跨為中央開槽的流線形雙鋼箱梁，背跨為預力混凝土雙箱梁，兩座單柱塔下段為混凝土、上段為雙相不鏽鋼外皮的鋼—混凝土複合結構。本課從颱風風荷載、塔梁液壓緩衝器、224 根斜拉索、鋼箱梁吊裝與鋼混接頭，一路到雷諾數效應的風洞試驗、跨中撓度監測與長索維護。
catalog.summaryEn: Stonecutters Bridge crosses Hong Kong’s Rambler Channel with a 1,018 m main span of streamlined twin steel boxes separated by a central gap, prestressed concrete twin-box back spans and two monopole towers whose lower parts are concrete and upper parts steel–concrete composite with a duplex stainless skin. The course runs from typhoon wind load, tower–deck hydraulic buffers, the 224 stays, deck-segment lifting and the steel–concrete junction to Reynolds-number effects in wind testing, mid-span deflection monitoring and long-stay maintenance.

catalog.title: 蘇通長江公路大橋
catalog.summary: 蘇通長江公路大橋以 1,088 m 主跨跨越寬約 6 km 的長江口，主橋孔跨為 (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m，倒 Y 形混凝土塔高 300.4 m，鋼箱梁含風嘴寬約 41 m，最長斜索約 577 m。本課從縱向阻尼限位體系、高空風剖面、每塔 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁、鋼錨箱錨固區出發，經施工平台與節段同步提升，到氣彈模型、沖刷監測、塔柱徐變與長索多模態振動。
catalog.summaryEn: Sutong Yangtze River Bridge spans the roughly 6 km wide Yangtze estuary with a 1,088 m main span in a (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m arrangement, 300.4 m inverted-Y concrete towers, a steel box deck about 41 m wide including fairings and stays up to about 577 m long. The course runs from the longitudinal damper–limiter system, wind profiles at height, the 131 bored friction piles per tower and steel anchor boxes, through work platforms and synchronised segment lifting, to aeroelastic testing, scour monitoring, tower creep and multi-mode vibration of long stays.

catalog.title: 港珠澳大橋橋梁段
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
catalog.summary: 港珠澳大橋主體工程以約 22.9 公里橋梁、6.7 公里沉管隧道與兩座人工島跨越伶仃洋，設計壽命 120 年。本課聚焦橋梁段：青州、江海直達船與九洲三座通航孔斜張橋，以及以鋼箱梁和鋼—混凝土組合梁構成的非通航孔連續梁；從颱風與地震設計基準、大節段鋼箱梁與組合梁、整體吊裝與颱風季的工法變更，到風洞試驗、製造檢驗、防腐與三地共管的監測交接。
catalog.summaryEn: The main works of the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge cross the Lingdingyang with about 22.9 km of bridge, a 6.7 km immersed tunnel and two artificial islands, designed for 120 years. This course focuses on the bridge works: the Qingzhou, Jianghai and Jiuzhou navigation-channel cable-stayed bridges and the non-navigable continuous spans of steel box and steel–concrete composite girders, moving from the typhoon and earthquake design basis, large steel box segments and composite girders, single-piece lifts and a typhoon-season method change, to wind-tunnel testing, fabrication inspection, corrosion protection and monitoring handover under joint tri-party management.

catalog.title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋
catalog.summary: 里翁—安提里翁大橋以 286+3×560+286 m 共 2,252 m 的連續全懸吊橋面跨越希臘科林斯灣口，四座塔立在直徑 90 m、坐於 3 m 礫石層上的基礎，下方以 2 m 鋼管插入物加勁軟弱海床。本課從 0.48 g 地震與 2 m 斷層位移、熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器、加勁土壤與沉箱浮運，到張力腿駁船的海床整備、平衡懸臂架設、WEASHM 監測、雷擊斷索與混凝土耐久。
catalog.summaryEn: The Rion–Antirion Bridge crosses the mouth of the Gulf of Corinth with a 2,252 m continuous fully suspended deck of 286+3×560+286 m; its four pylons stand on 90 m diameter footings resting on a 3 m gravel layer above soft seabed reinforced with 2 m steel-pipe inclusions. The course runs from 0.48 g shaking and 2 m fault movement, fuse restrainers and viscous dampers, reinforced soil and floating caissons, to seabed preparation from a tension-leg barge, balanced-cantilever erection, the WEASHM monitoring system, the lightning-caused stay failure and concrete durability.

catalog.title: 諾曼第大橋
catalog.summary: 諾曼第大橋 1995 年通車時以 856 m 主跨創下斜張橋紀錄：主跨中央 624 m 為正交異性鋼箱梁，兩端各 116 m 與背跨為預力混凝土，184 根鋼絞線斜索掛在兩座約 214 m 高的倒 Y 形混凝土塔上。本課從混合主梁的重量配置、倒 Y 形塔的抗扭貢獻、斜索與樁基，經混凝土平衡懸臂與鋼節段吊裝，到現地風量測、長索振動與阻尼器加裝、斜索多層防腐與單股更換。
catalog.summaryEn: When it opened in 1995 the Pont de Normandie set the cable-stayed span record at 856 m: the central 624 m of the main span is an orthotropic steel box, while 116 m at each end and the back spans are prestressed concrete, and 184 strand stays hang from two inverted-Y concrete pylons about 214 m tall. The course runs from the weight layout of the hybrid deck, the torsional contribution of the inverted-Y pylons, stays and piles, through concrete balanced cantilevers and steel-segment lifting, to on-site wind measurement, long-stay vibration and retrofitted dampers, multi-layer stay corrosion protection and single-strand replacement.

catalog.title: 聯邦大橋（加拿大）
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
catalog.summary: 聯邦大橋連接愛德華王子島與新布倫瑞克省，全長約 12.9 公里，是跨越冬季結冰海域最長的橋梁，主橋段以約 250 公尺的跨徑排列，設計壽命 100 年。本課從浮冰荷載與冰盾錐體出發，拆解主梁懸臂與掛梁組成的預製體系、高性能混凝土與墩身接合，再看陸上預製場、浮吊 Svanen 與高峰期每週一跨的安裝節奏，最後談冰力監測、強風管制、除冰鹽與凍融，以及 2032 年特許營運結束時的交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Confederation Bridge links Prince Edward Island and New Brunswick over about 12.9 km, the longest bridge over ice-covered water, with main spans of about 250 m and a 100-year design life. Starting from pack-ice loads and the ice-shield cones, the course unpacks the precast system of cantilevered main girders and drop-in spans, high-performance concrete and pier joints, then the land casting yard, the floating crane Svanen and a peak rate of one span a week, ending with ice-force monitoring, wind restrictions, de-icing salt and freeze–thaw, and the handover when the concession ends in 2032.

catalog.title: 雪梨港灣大橋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
catalog.summary: 雪梨港灣大橋是跨度 503 公尺的雙鉸鋼拱橋，拱頂高出水面 134 公尺，橋面同時承載公路、鐵路、自行車道與人行道，1932 年通車。本課從雙鉸拱的推力與荷載路徑出發，分析桁架深度變化、鉚接與支承銷，再拆解兩岸以 128 條隧道錨碇鋼索支撐半拱懸臂架設、1930 年拱頂合龍與 1932 年 96 輛機車的載重試驗，最後談鉚接細節的疲勞評估、大面積塗裝維護，以及作為工程遺產的修繕與交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Sydney Harbour Bridge is a two-hinged steel arch spanning 503 m, its crown 134 m above the water, carrying road, rail, cycleway and footway since 1932. Starting from the thrust and load path of a two-hinged arch, the course examines varying truss depth, riveting and bearing pins, then the cantilever erection of each half-arch held back by 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels, the 1930 crown closure and the 1932 load test with 96 locomotives, ending with fatigue assessment of riveted details, painting of a vast steel surface and repair and handover of an engineering heritage structure.

catalog.title: 新河峽大橋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
catalog.summary: 新河峽大橋位於美國西維吉尼亞州，主拱跨度 1,700 英尺（約 518 公尺），全長 3,030 英尺（約 924 公尺），橋面高出新河約 876 英尺（約 267 公尺），1977 年通車，以免塗裝的 COR-TEN 耐候鋼建造。本課從兩鉸桁架拱與峽谷地形出發，分析排架立柱、上承式桁架、焊接箱形弦桿與低溫韌性，再拆解跨越峽谷的纜索吊運、以油井套管作背拉索的懸臂架設與 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂完成的合龍，最後談線形量測、載重評等、耐候鋼維護與橋梁日活動的管理。
catalog.summaryEn: New River Gorge Bridge in West Virginia has a 1,700 ft (about 518 m) arch, a total length of 3,030 ft (about 924 m) and a deck about 876 ft (about 267 m) above the New River; it opened in 1977, built of unpainted COR-TEN weathering steel. Starting from the two-hinged truss arch and the gorge, the course examines spandrel bents, deck trusses, welded box chords and low-temperature toughness, then the cableway across the gorge, cantilever erection held by oil-well-casing tiebacks and the 1976 closure with 16 hydraulic jacks, ending with geometry surveys, load rating, care of weathering steel and managing Bridge Day.

catalog.title: 皇后渡口大橋
catalog.summary: 皇后渡口大橋含引橋全長約 2.7 km，三座約 207 m 高的單柱塔支承 221+650+650+221 m 的斜張橋段，通車時為全球最長的三塔斜張橋，也是規模最大、斜索在跨中交叉的斜張橋。本課從中塔缺乏背索錨固的問題、交叉索的勁度、鋼—混凝土組合橋面與塔基沉箱，經平衡懸臂吊裝與兩處合龍，到防風屏障與車輛穩定、約 2,000 個感測器的監測、積冰掉落與營運檢查交接。
catalog.summaryEn: The Queensferry Crossing is about 2.7 km long including approaches; three monopole towers about 207 m tall carry a 221+650+650+221 m cable-stayed section, making it, at opening, the world’s longest three-tower cable-stayed bridge and the largest with stays that cross at mid-span. The course runs from the central tower’s lack of back-stay anchorage, the stiffness of crossing stays, the composite steel–concrete deck and tower caissons, through balanced-cantilever lifting and two closures, to wind shielding and vehicle stability, monitoring with about 2,000 sensors, falling ice and operational inspection handover.

catalog.title: 伊拉斯謨大橋
catalog.summary: 鹿特丹的伊拉斯謨大橋全長 802 m，以 139 m 高、彎折不對稱的鋼塔支承約 284 m 的斜張主跨，南端另有 89 m 的開合橋；橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根箱形主梁與每 4.9 m 一道的橫梁組成，承載車道、電車軌道與人行自行車道。本課從背索如何降低塔的彎矩、橋面橫向受力、鋼塔焊接、開合橋配重與電車軌伸縮，到 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測、調諧液壓阻尼器、塗裝與開合機械的長期維護。
catalog.summaryEn: Rotterdam’s Erasmus Bridge is 802 m long; a bent, asymmetric 139 m steel pylon carries a cable-stayed main span of about 284 m, and an 89 m bascule sits at the south end. The 33.8 m deck, two box spines with cross beams every 4.9 m, carries traffic lanes, tram tracks, footpaths and cycle tracks. The course runs from how back stays cut pylon bending, transverse deck action, pylon welding, bascule counterweighting and tram-rail expansion, to observation of rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening, tuned hydraulic dampers and long-term care of coatings and bascule machinery.

catalog.title: 瀨戶大橋橋群
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 懸索橋巨作與主纜系統
catalog.summary: 瀨戶大橋是連接本州岡山與四國香川的六座橋梁，海峽段約 9.4 km，全部為上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層結構，1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。本課從如何沿海峽配置三座懸索橋、兩座斜張橋與一座桁架橋出發，說明南北備讚瀨戶大橋的三跨連續構造與索股交叉的共用錨碇、11 座設置沉箱與預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與工廠全尺寸預組，最後談鍍鋅鋼絲防蝕、乾燥空氣與公路鐵路並存下的維護。
catalog.summaryEn: Seto Ohashi is a group of six bridges linking Okayama on Honshu with Kagawa on Shikoku across about 9.4 km of sea, all double-deck with road above and rail below, opened together on 10 April 1988. The course starts from how three suspension bridges, two cable-stayed bridges and a truss bridge were arranged along the strait, explains the three-span continuous Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto bridges and their shared anchorage where strands cross, eleven placed caissons with prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and full factory trial assembly, and ends with galvanised-wire protection, dry air and maintenance with road and rail side by side.

catalog.title: 東京晴空塔
catalog.summary: 從三角形基底到圓形頂部的塔身斷面與格構風力出發，理解心柱與鋼塔之間以油壓阻尼器耦合的減振機制，計算直徑 2.3 m 鋼管與節狀壁樁的容量，再處理日照彎曲下的施工測量、在中央豎井內頂升天線塔、阻尼器的雙線性特性驗證、2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查，最後是冬季落冰與鋼管塔的防蝕維護。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the tower's triangle-to-circle section and the wind force on an open lattice, understand how the central column and steel tower are coupled through oil dampers to reduce vibration, compute the capacity of 2.3 m steel tubes and knuckle-wall piles, then handle construction surveys under solar bowing, lifting the antenna mast inside the central shaft, verifying bilinear damper behaviour, inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake, and finally falling ice and corrosion upkeep of a tubular steel tower.

catalog.title: 吉隆坡雙子星塔
catalog.summary: 從核心筒與周邊柱環的側力分工、以混凝土重量換取低加速度出發，計算高強度混凝土圓柱的容量與空橋支腳的轉角，再處理避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基、兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制、高強度混凝土驗收與雙塔風洞干擾，最後是熱帶氣候下的外牆維護與空橋作為避難路徑的交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from lateral load sharing between the core and the perimeter column ring and from trading concrete weight for low acceleration, compute the capacity of high-strength concrete columns and the rotation of the skybridge legs, then handle the site shift away from a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts, geometry control with two contractors working in parallel, high-strength concrete acceptance and twin-tower wind interference, ending with façade upkeep in a tropical climate and the handover of the skybridge as an escape route.

catalog.title: 世界貿易中心一號大樓
catalog.summary: 世界貿易中心一號大樓以約 61 m 見方的基座、逐漸削角收分的體量，把 14,000 psi 高強混凝土核心筒與周邊延性抗彎鋼框架組成混合抗側系統，再以展開基腳與岩錨坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上。本課從削角形體的風荷載、核心筒剛度與替代傳力路徑，走到岩盤基腳、尖塔分段吊裝、大體積高強混凝土的溫控與驗收，最後談強健性設計在營運期的改裝管制與尖塔維護。
catalog.summaryEn: One World Trade Center rises from a base about 61 m square with chamfered, tapering faces, combining a 14,000 psi high-strength concrete core and a ductile perimeter steel moment frame into a hybrid lateral system founded on Manhattan bedrock with spread footings and rock anchors. The course moves from wind on the chamfered form, core stiffness and alternate load paths to rock footings, staged spire erection, temperature control and acceptance of high-strength mass concrete, and finally to protecting robustness during later alterations and maintaining the spire.

catalog.title: 樂天世界塔
catalog.summary: 樂天世界塔高 554.5 m、地上 123 層，以鋼筋混凝土核心筒與八根巨柱承擔重力與側力，兩道外伸臂與多道帶狀桁架把巨柱與核心筒綁在一起，並把頂部斜交網格燈籠與飯店柱轉換到巨柱上。基礎是 6.5 m 厚的筏基，斷層帶以不與筏基相連的補強樁改良地盤。本課沿著重力分擔、外伸臂、巨柱細長效應、帶狀桁架延遲鎖定、筏基一次澆置、預拱、監測與長期潛變，拆解這座韓國最高建築的工程邏輯。
catalog.summaryEn: Lotte World Tower is 554.5 m tall with 123 storeys above ground; a reinforced-concrete core and eight mega-columns carry gravity and lateral load, two outrigger levels and several belt trusses tie the columns to the core and transfer the diagrid lantern and hotel columns onto the mega-columns. It stands on a 6.5 m thick mat, with ground-reinforcing piles, not connected to the mat, improving fault zones. The course follows gravity sharing, outriggers, mega-column slenderness, delayed locking of belt trusses, a single-pour mat, camber, monitoring and long-term creep to unpack Korea's tallest building.

catalog.title: 威利斯大樓
catalog.summary: 威利斯大樓（原希爾斯大樓）由 Fazlur Khan 與 SOM 設計，九個 75 ft（22.9 m）見方的鋼框管組成 225 ft 見方的束筒，管筒在 50、66、90 層分批終止，只留兩管到頂。本課從束筒如何以內部框架減少剪力遲滯、分段收進如何降低質心與造成扭轉，到 15 ft 柱距框管、75 ft 複合樓板桁架、每週兩層的鋼構安裝與岩盤沉箱，再到週期量測、外牆熱隔離，以及 2017–2020 年在營運中改造底座時的柱補強與傳力路徑管理。
catalog.summaryEn: Willis Tower, formerly Sears Tower, designed by Fazlur Khan and SOM, bundles nine 75 ft (22.9 m) square steel framed tubes into a 225 ft square plan; the tubes stop in groups at floors 50, 66 and 90, leaving two to the top. The course covers how interior frames reduce shear lag, how staged terminations lower the mass centroid and create torsion, the 15 ft column module, 75 ft composite floor trusses, erection at two floors a week and rock caissons, then period measurement, thermal isolation by the skin, and column strengthening and load-path control during the 2017–2020 base repositioning of the occupied tower.

catalog.title: 香港環球貿易廣場
catalog.summary: 環球貿易廣場高 484 m、地上 108 層（樓層編號至 118），坐落在西九龍填海區的九龍站上方。結構以鋼筋混凝土核心筒、八根巨柱與四道外伸臂組成，最低一道為預力混凝土外伸臂，其餘三道為鋼構；凹角平面與上部 1° 內傾減弱颱風下的渦流激振，巨柱在底部外撇約 3°。岩盤深約 70 至 130 m 且起伏如懸崖，因此改用平均深約 70 m 的灌漿摩擦型壁樁。本課從颱風風荷載、外伸臂、預力與外撇巨柱，到壁樁施工、高空風速管控、風洞縮尺、載重試驗、海埔地耐久與颱風後交接。
catalog.summaryEn: The International Commerce Centre is 484 m tall with 108 storeys above ground (numbered to 118), standing over Kowloon Station on West Kowloon reclamation. Its structure combines a reinforced-concrete core, eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels, the lowest in prestressed concrete and the other three in steel; notched corners and a 1° inward lean of the upper façades weaken typhoon vortex excitation, and the mega-columns splay outward about 3° at the base. With bedrock about 70 to 130 m down in a cliff-like profile, shaft-grouted friction barrettes averaging about 70 m deep were used. The course runs from typhoon wind, outriggers, prestress and splayed columns to barrette construction, wind control at height, wind-tunnel scaling, load testing, durability on reclaimed land and post-typhoon handover.

catalog.title: 碎片大廈
catalog.summary: 碎片大廈由 Renzo Piano 設計、WSP 擔任結構設計、Mace 承建，官方高度 309.6 m、共 95 層。結構依用途分區：下部辦公層為複合鋼構，上部飯店與住宅層為 200 mm 後拉預力混凝土平板，塔頂以鋼構「散熱器」與桅桿收尾；中央混凝土核心筒是主要抗側骨幹，以費氏桁架與 A 形轉換調整柱距。英國首次採用由上而下的核心筒施工，讓核心筒在地下室開挖時同步上升。本課涵蓋分區質量、扭轉、預力樓板、轉換構件、由上而下施工、尖塔與塔吊、風洞、鄰近鐵路監測、帷幕牆與帽桁架的交接。
catalog.summaryEn: The Shard, designed by Renzo Piano with WSP as structural designer and Mace as contractor, is officially 309.6 m tall with 95 storeys. Its structure is zoned by use: composite steel for the lower offices, 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs for the hotel and homes above, and a steel radiator and mast at the crown; a central concrete core is the main lateral spine, with Vierendeel trusses and A-frames changing column spacing. It was the first UK use of top-down core construction, letting the core rise while the basement was being dug. The course covers zoned mass, torsion, post-tensioned slabs, transfer structures, top-down construction, spire and cranes, wind-tunnel testing, monitoring of adjacent rail assets, curtain-wall joints and the handover of hat trusses.

catalog.title: 雪梨歌劇院
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 從烏戎競圖中無法計算的帆形輪廓出發，說明 Arup 如何以半徑約 75 m 的共同球面把屋殼改為預鑄肋拱，再處理肋段斷面、環氧膠結與後拉預力、伸縮式架設拱與逐段吊裝、電腦化幾何控制，以及風洞與結構模型驗證。最後談海港環境中瓷磚蓋板扣件、預力與混凝土的耐久，以及世界遺產建築的檢測與交接紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from Utzon's competition sails that could not be calculated, the course shows how Arup turned the shells into precast rib arches cut from a common sphere of about 75 m radius, then covers rib sections, epoxy bonding and post-tensioning, telescopic erection arches and segment-by-segment lifting, computerised geometry control, and wind-tunnel and structural-model verification. It ends with the durability of tile-lid fixings, prestress and concrete in a harbour environment and the inspection and handover records of a World Heritage building.

catalog.title: 北京國家體育場
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 北京國家體育場（鳥巢）把屋蓋、立面與樓梯整合成一個由交織平面桁架構成的鋼結構外殼，屋蓋平面約 313 m × 266 m，與內部混凝土看台結構完全分離。課程從空間門式結構與三級地震性能目標出發，處理 1.2 m 箱形桿件的板厚與扭曲面、複雜節點的原型試驗、78 個臨時支撐點上的分段組裝與分級卸載，再談溫度與施工監測、ETFE 與 PTFE 雙層膜、防蝕排水維護與賽後再利用。
catalog.summaryEn: The Beijing National Stadium, the Bird's Nest, merges roof, façade and stairs into one steel shell of interlaced plane trusses, about 313 m × 266 m on plan and fully separated from the concrete seating bowl inside. The course starts from the portalised space-truss system and three-level seismic performance targets, then covers plate thickness and twisted surfaces of 1.2 m box members, prototype tests of congested nodes, sectional assembly and staged unloading on 78 temporary support points, thermal and construction monitoring, the double ETFE and PTFE membranes, corrosion and drainage maintenance and post-Games reuse.

catalog.title: 新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 濱海灣金沙空中花園是長約 340 m、最寬約 40 m 的鋼構平台，以巨型桁架與鋼箱梁跨越三座 55 層混凝土塔樓，並在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m。課程從三塔相對變位與懸臂人致振動出發，處理鋼箱梁與後拉預力、塔頂 V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承、1,270 t 箱梁以鋼絞線千斤頂提升到約 200 m、塔樓斜腿的施工控制，再談提升監測、阻尼器驗收、無邊際泳池接縫調平與長期徐變維護。
catalog.summaryEn: The Marina Bay Sands SkyPark is a steel platform about 340 m long and up to about 40 m wide that bridges three 55-storey concrete towers with mega-trusses and steel box girders and cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower. The course starts from relative tower movement and crowd-induced vibration of the cantilever, then covers box girders and post-tensioning, rooftop V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings, strand-jack lifting of a 1,270 t girder pair to about 200 m and construction control of the leaning tower legs, before turning to lift monitoring, damper acceptance, infinity-pool joints and levelling, and long-term creep and maintenance.

catalog.title: 倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 千禧巨蛋並非結構意義上的穹頂，而是由 12 支約 100 m 高的桅桿以吊索與拉索撐起的穹形索網，上覆 PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維膜，整個屋頂比室內空氣還輕。課程從索網與桅桿的傳力、輕屋蓋的荷載反轉出發，處理膜材選擇、索夾與吊索節點、地面組裝後絞升索網、索長精度與預張力，再談風洞試驗的雷諾數問題、索力現場量測、2022 年風暴後的膜片更換，以及改建為 The O2 時的荷載管理。
catalog.summaryEn: The Millennium Dome is not a dome in the structural sense but a dome-shaped cable net held up by hanger and tie-down cables from 12 masts about 100 m high and clad in PTFE-coated glass-fibre fabric, the whole roof weighing less than the air inside. The course starts from the load path of net and masts and load reversal on a lightweight roof, then covers fabric choice, clamps and hanger nodes, winching the ground-assembled net, cable-length accuracy and pretension, Reynolds-number issues in wind-tunnel tests, field measurement of cable forces, panel replacement after the 2022 storm and load control during conversion to The O2.

catalog.title: 慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 慕尼黑奧林匹克公園的帳篷屋蓋由多片鞍形索網組成，總面積約 74,800 m²，覆蓋體育場、體育館與游泳館，網目統一為 75 × 75 cm，上鋪約 8,300 片壓克力板。課程從負高斯曲率索網的預拉平衡與邊索、桅桿、重力錨塊的傳力出發，處理等網目索網與鑄鋼節點、壓克力板的熱脹與接合、地面編網吊升與預拉力導入，再談由實體模型走向迭代電腦計算的形狀確認、安裝量測、板材老化更換，以及列管古蹟屋蓋的重新計算與維護。
catalog.summaryEn: The tent roof of Munich's Olympic Park consists of several saddle-shaped cable nets totalling about 74,800 m² over the stadium, arena and swimming hall, all with a uniform 75 × 75 cm mesh and covered by about 8,300 acrylic panels. The course starts from prestress equilibrium of anticlastic nets and the load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchor blocks, then covers the uniform-mesh net and cast-steel nodes, thermal movement and fixing of acrylic panels, ground assembly, lifting and introduction of pretension, and the move from physical models to iterative computer form finding, before turning to as-built survey, panel ageing and replacement, and recalculation and maintenance of a listed roof.

catalog.title: 懸索橋主纜架設
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 懸索橋巨作與主纜系統
catalog.summary: 主纜是懸索橋唯一幾乎無法更換的主構件，它的品質在架設時就已決定。本課比較空中紡線（金門大橋、大貝爾特東橋）與預製平行鋼絲索股（明石海峽大橋、瀨戶大橋、1915 恰納卡萊大橋）兩種工法，計算裸纜懸鏈線、索鞍彎曲應力、貓道張力與擠壓後直徑，說明鋼絲等級與鍍層、索股量測與統計允收，並依美國聯邦公路總署的指引談開纜檢查、腐蝕分級與剩餘強度評估。
catalog.summaryEn: The main cable is the one primary member of a suspension bridge that can almost never be replaced, and its quality is fixed during erection. This course compares aerial spinning (Golden Gate, Great Belt East) with prefabricated parallel-wire strands (Akashi Kaikyo, Seto Ohashi, 1915 Çanakkale), computes bare-cable catenaries, saddle bending stress, catwalk tension and compacted diameter, explains wire grades and coatings, strand survey and statistical acceptance, and, following US Federal Highway Administration guidance, covers cable openings, corrosion staging and remaining-strength evaluation.

catalog.title: 斜張橋斜索張力調整
catalog.summary: 斜張橋的線形與內力幾乎完全由斜索索力決定，索力調整是把設計意圖變成實際結構的核心工序。本課以諾曼第大橋、里翁—安提里翁大橋、蘇通大橋與亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋等公開案例為參照，說明成橋目標索力、影響矩陣法、平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉、錨具調整量、施工階段預拱、溫度修正、振動法與舉升試驗量測、長期索力漂移，以及允收準則與營運期再調整的決策流程。
catalog.summaryEn: The profile and internal forces of a cable-stayed bridge are set almost entirely by its stay forces, so tuning them is the core operation that turns design intent into the real structure. Referring to public cases such as the Pont de Normandie, Rion–Antirion, Sutong and Yavuz Sultan Selim bridges, the course explains completed-state target forces, the influence-matrix method, strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing, anchorage adjustment, construction-stage camber, temperature correction, vibration and lift-off measurement, long-term force drift, and acceptance criteria and in-service re-tuning decisions.

catalog.title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
catalog.summary: 從懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁出發，計算施工期不平衡荷載與墩頂臨時固結，再處理懸臂鋼腱、節塊接縫、懸臂工作車循環、溫度與潛變造成的線形偏差與跨中閉合，最後以伸長量、測量回饋與長期撓度監測驗證，並以 Bendorf 橋、Stolma 橋與 Koror–Babeldaob 橋的成敗對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder, compute construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary pier fixity, then handle cantilever tendons, segment joints, the form-traveler cycle, thermal and creep effects on geometry and the midspan closure, and finally verify with elongations, survey feedback and long-term deflection monitoring, contrasting Bendorf, Stolma and the Koror–Babeldaob bridge.

catalog.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
catalog.summary: 從簡支箱梁的正彎矩與體外預力需求出發，計算架橋機對橋墩的施工荷載，再處理乾接縫與環氧接縫、轉向塊與錨碇橫隔、架橋機推進穩定、整跨荷重轉換與預製場幾何控制，最後以鋼腱振動頻率、接縫監測與可更換性驗收交接，並以佛州 Long Key 橋、Seven Mile 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路為案例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the sagging moment and external prestress demand of a simple-span box girder, compute gantry construction loads on the piers, then handle dry and epoxy joints, deviators and anchorage diaphragms, gantry launching stability, whole-span load transfer and casting-yard geometry control, and finally accept and hand over with tendon vibration checks, joint monitoring and replaceability, using Florida's Long Key and Seven Mile bridges and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway as cases.

catalog.title: 橋梁頂推施工
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
catalog.summary: 從頂推過程中每一斷面輪流經過墩頂與跨中所產生的交變彎矩出發，計算導梁長度與中心預力需求，再處理導梁上墩、滑移支承與側向導向、橋台後預製台座的每週循環、臨時墩與鋼橋面頂推，最後以支承反力、頂推力與摩擦監測驗證並完成永久支承安裝與交接，案例涵蓋 Caroní 橋、Kufstein 茵河橋、Ravensbosch 高架橋與 Millau 高架橋。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the alternating moments that arise as every section passes alternately over piers and midspans, compute launching-nose length and centric prestress, then handle nose landing, sliding bearings and lateral guides, the weekly cycle of the casting bed behind the abutment, temporary piers and steel-deck launching, and finally verify with support reactions, launch force and friction monitoring before installing permanent bearings and handing over, with the Caroní, Kufstein Inn, Ravensbosch and Millau bridges as cases.

catalog.title: 橋梁轉體施工
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
catalog.summary: 從平行於鐵路、道路或河道建造、再轉到跨越位置的工法邏輯出發，計算轉體重量、重心偏心與撐腳間隙，再處理球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩、下轉盤局部承壓、牽引系統、到位精調與封鉸，最後以稱重試驗、轉動監測與封固後的沉陷與淨空檢核驗收，並以比利時 Ben-Ahin 斜張橋、塞維亞 Barqueta 拱橋的浮力旋轉與石板坡鋼箱梁的轉向對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the logic of building parallel to a railway, road or river and then swinging into the crossing position, compute rotating weight, centre-of-gravity eccentricity and support-leg gaps, then handle spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque, local bearing in the lower turntable, the traction system, final positioning and hinge encasement, and finally accept with a weighing test, rotation monitoring and post-encasement settlement and clearance checks, contrasting Belgium's Ben-Ahin cable-stayed bridge, the floating swing of Seville's Barqueta arch and the turning of the Shibanpo steel box.

catalog.title: 鋼拱橋拱肋合龍
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
catalog.summary: 大跨度鋼拱多半以兩側半拱懸臂伸出、在拱頂合龍的方式架設，合龍是整個施工中結構體系改變最劇烈、對幾何與溫度最敏感的時刻。本課以雪梨港灣大橋 1930 年放索合龍、新河峽大橋 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂下放合龍，以及上海盧浦大橋以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設為例，說明合龍前後的力學、架設方法選擇、合龍段構造、溫度場、線形調整、鎖定時機、扣索卸載與驗收，最後談強迫對位的風險與合龍紀錄的交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Most long-span steel arches are built by cantilevering half-arches from both sides and closing them at the crown, and closure is the moment of the most drastic system change in the whole erection, the most sensitive to geometry and temperature. Using the 1930 cable-release closure of Sydney Harbour Bridge, the 1976 jack-down closure of New River Gorge Bridge with 16 jacks and the temporary cable-stayed cantilevering of Shanghai's Lupu Bridge, the course explains the mechanics before and after closure, choice of erection method, closure-segment detailing, temperature fields, geometry adjustment, locking time, tieback release and acceptance, ending with the risks of forced fit and the handover of closure records.

catalog.title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
catalog.summary: 從輪載經面板、縱肋、橫梁到主梁的局部與整體傳力出發，以疲勞為主控計算面板厚度，再處理 U 形肋冷彎、肋—面板部分滲透焊、面板單元焊接變形、工地拼接收縮、非破壞檢測與試拼裝，最後以鋪面協同、疲勞熱點檢查與裂縫成長評估交接，並以金門大橋 1982 至 1986 年換裝鋼橋面、Lions Gate 橋與 Millau 高架橋為案例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the local and global load path from wheel to deck plate, ribs, floorbeams and main girders, size the deck plate with fatigue governing, then handle cold-formed U-ribs, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, panel welding distortion, site-splice shrinkage, non-destructive testing and trial assembly, and finally hand over with surfacing interaction, fatigue hot-spot inspection and crack-growth assessment, using the Golden Gate Bridge's 1982–1986 redecking, Lions Gate and Millau as cases.

catalog.title: 橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 支承、伸縮縫與橋梁耐震
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bearings, joints and bridge seismic design
catalog.summary: 從溫度、乾縮、潛變與活載造成的梁端位移出發，決定伸縮縫型式與間隙數，檢核中梁輪載衝擊與疲勞，再處理錨碇箱與後澆混凝土、安裝溫度預設、通車條件下的分幅更換、出廠疲勞與防水試驗、現場間隙—溫度量測，最後以止水排水維護與生命週期更換策略交接，並以新 Tappan Zee 橋的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫、Øresund 橋的旋轉橫梁伸縮縫更換與漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋伸縮縫翻修為案例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from girder-end movements due to temperature, shrinkage, creep and live load, choose the joint type and number of gaps and check centre-beam wheel impact and fatigue, then handle anchorage boxes and blockout concrete, temperature presetting at installation, staged replacement under traffic, factory fatigue and watertightness tests and field gap–temperature measurements, and finally hand over with seal and drainage maintenance and a life-cycle replacement strategy, using the LR18 modular joints of the new Tappan Zee crossing, the swivel-joist joint replacement on the Øresund Bridge and the joint rehabilitation of Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge as cases.

catalog.title: 球面支承安裝
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 支承、伸縮縫與橋梁耐震
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bearings, joints and bridge seismic design
catalog.summary: 從支承配置與熱位移出發，量化球面支承的轉角需求、滑動材料承壓、曲面摩擦力矩與偏心，再處理工廠預設偏移、墊層灌漿、運輸固定件拆除、型式試驗、現場位移指標與累積滑移磨耗，最後以萊茵河上兩座斜張橋的 120 MN 級球面支承更換與新建案例，說明頂升更換與交接紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from bearing layout and thermal movement, quantify a spherical bearing's rotation demand, sliding-material pressure, curved-surface friction moment and eccentricity, then handle factory presetting, bedding grout, removal of transport fittings, type testing, movement indicators and accumulated sliding wear, closing with jacking replacement and handover records through 120 MN class spherical bearings on two Rhine cable-stayed bridges.

catalog.title: 鉛心橡膠支承隔震
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 支承、伸縮縫與橋梁耐震
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bearings, joints and bridge seismic design
catalog.summary: 從週期移轉與設計反應譜出發，以雙線性模型量化鉛心橡膠支承的特徵強度、屈服後勁度、等效週期與阻尼，再處理疊層橡膠的形狀係數與應變、安裝初始偏移、常時約束與隔震縫、原型與量產試驗、振動台驗證、材料性質上下限與震後檢查，並以紐西蘭最早的隔震橋、金門大橋引道高架橋改造與 921 地震後的集鹿大橋研究為例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from period shift and the design spectrum, use a bilinear model to quantify a lead-rubber bearing's characteristic strength, post-yield stiffness, effective period and damping, then handle laminated-rubber shape factor and strains, initial installation offset, service restraint and isolation gaps, prototype and production tests, shake-table verification, property bounds and post-earthquake inspection, drawing on New Zealand's first isolated bridges, the Golden Gate Bridge approach-viaduct retrofit and post-Chi-Chi studies of the Chi-Lu Bridge.

catalog.title: 橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
catalog.titleEn: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 支承、伸縮縫與橋梁耐震
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bearings, joints and bridge seismic design
catalog.summary: 從 1989 年賽普勒斯高架橋、1995 年阪神高速神戶線與 1999 年 921 地震的橋墩破壞出發，建立容量設計層級與位移韌性需求，量化圍束箍筋、塑鉸長度與轉角容量，再處理箍筋與續接器施工、反覆載重試驗、震後殘留漂移、塑鉸區腐蝕與既有橋墩的剪力退化評估，說明為何塑鉸只能出現在預先選定、詳細配筋且可檢查的位置。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from pier failures in the 1989 Cypress Viaduct, the 1995 Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route and the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake, build the capacity-design hierarchy and displacement-ductility demand, quantify confinement, plastic-hinge length and rotation capacity, then cover hoop and coupler construction, cyclic testing, residual drift, hinge-zone corrosion and shear degradation in existing piers, explaining why plastic hinges may form only at preselected, well-detailed and inspectable locations.

catalog.title: 橋墩纖維複材耐震補強
catalog.titleEn: FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 支承、伸縮縫與橋梁耐震
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bearings, joints and bridge seismic design
catalog.summary: 從舊橋墩的剪力、圍束與柱底搭接三種缺陷出發，說明纖維複材套管為何只沿環向布纖維、如何以側向圍束壓力與有效應變計算層數與剪力貢獻，再處理表面處理、露點與圓角、濕式積層、拉拔與脫層檢驗、補強前後反覆載重驗證、紫外線與撞擊耐久以及震後量測，並以賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年的塑鉸區包覆與舊金山碼頭 250 支沉箱套管為例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the three deficiencies of old piers — shear, confinement and base lap splices — explain why FRP jackets place fibres only in the hoop direction and how confining pressure and effective strain set ply count and shear contribution, then cover surface preparation, dew point and corner rounding, wet lay-up, pull-off and delamination checks, cyclic validation before and after retrofit, UV and impact durability and post-earthquake measurement, using the 1995 plastic-hinge wrapping of a Pennsylvania I-84 overpass and jackets on about 250 caissons of a San Francisco pier.

catalog.title: 橋梁基礎沖刷監測
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
catalog.summary: 從長期河床降低、束縮沖刷與橋墩局部沖刷三個分量出發，以 HEC-18 公式估算沖刷深度並評估擴展基礎與樁基的暴露後果，再處理拋石保護、聲納與磁性滑環等固定式監測儀的安裝、施工期河道束縮、即時警戒值、振動頻率識別、行動計畫與洪後檢查，並以 1987 年紐約 Schoharie 溪橋、2000 年高屏大橋與 2008 年后豐大橋的斷橋為鑑。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the three components of long-term degradation, contraction scour and local pier scour, estimate scour depth with the HEC-18 equation and assess the consequences of exposure for spread footings and piles, then cover riprap protection, installation of fixed monitors such as sonar and magnetic sliding collars, construction-stage channel contraction, real-time alarm levels, vibration-based detection, plans of action and post-flood inspection, learning from the bridge failures of Schoharie Creek in New York (1987), Kaoping (2000) and Houfeng (2008).

catalog.title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
catalog.summary: 從 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋的扭轉顫振崩塌出發，建立橋面設計風速、氣動現象分類、斷面外形與扭轉勁度、Scruton 數等結構參數，再處理施工懸臂階段的抗風、節段模型的彈簧懸吊試驗與縮尺換算、全橋氣動彈性模型、營運期渦振與阻尼器改善以及改裝前的風洞複核，並以明石海峽大橋的全橋模型風洞試驗與伏爾加格勒大橋 2010 年振動事件為例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the torsional flutter collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940, establish deck design wind speed, the classes of aeroelastic phenomena, section shape and torsional stiffness and structural parameters such as the Scruton number, then cover wind resistance during cantilever erection, spring-mounted section-model tests and scaling, full aeroelastic models, in-service vortex vibration and damper retrofits and aerodynamic rechecks before modifications, using the full-model wind-tunnel tests of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge and the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge.

catalog.title: 斜張索雨風振動抑制
catalog.titleEn: Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables
catalog.summary: 雨風振動是斜張索在中等風速與降雨同時出現時發生的大振幅振動，1980 年代在日本名港西大橋首次被系統記錄，之後在諾曼第大橋與伊拉斯謨大橋等通車初期都曾出現。本課從上緣水線的氣動機制、史庫頓數門檻、HDPE 套管的螺旋凸肋，到外置與內置阻尼器的選型、交叉索、現場監測、自由衰減驗收、錨口彎曲疲勞與阻尼器維護，建立從量測到對策與驗收的完整流程。
catalog.summaryEn: Rain–wind vibration is a large-amplitude motion of stay cables that occurs when moderate wind and rain coincide; it was first systematically recorded on Japan’s Meiko-Nishi Bridge in the 1980s and later appeared soon after opening on bridges such as the Pont de Normandie and the Erasmus Bridge. The course builds a full workflow from measurement to remedy and acceptance: the aerodynamics of the upper rivulet, the Scruton number threshold, helical ribs on HDPE ducts, selection of external and internal dampers, cross-ties, field monitoring, free-decay acceptance, bending fatigue at the anchor exit and damper maintenance.

catalog.title: 懸索橋主纜除濕系統
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 懸索橋巨作與主纜系統
catalog.summary: 主纜內部的水分會先消耗鍍鋅層、再腐蝕高強度鋼絲，而主纜幾乎無法更換。本課以本州四國連絡橋首創的主纜乾燥空氣送氣（管理目標相對濕度 40%）與大貝爾特東橋 2014 至 2015 年的除濕改造為主軸，說明腐蝕門檻與露點、送氣與排氣流路、彈性體包覆與索夾密封、除濕機與預冷、改造施工與啟動乾燥曲線、感測器判讀與開纜比對，最後以能耗與生命週期比較說明業主如何決策。
catalog.summaryEn: Moisture inside a main cable first consumes the zinc and then corrodes high-strength wire, and the cable can almost never be replaced. Built around the Honshu-Shikoku bridges' pioneering dry-air cable injection (managed to 40% relative humidity) and the 2014–2015 dehumidification retrofit of the Great Belt East Bridge, this course explains corrosion thresholds and dew point, injection and exhaust flow paths, elastomeric wrapping and cable-band seals, dehumidifiers and pre-coolers, retrofit construction and the start-up dry-out curve, sensor interpretation and comparison with cable openings, and finally energy use and the life-cycle comparison behind an owner's decision.

catalog.title: 橋面超高性能混凝土接縫
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
catalog.summary: 從快速橋梁施工中預鑄橋面板接縫的荷載路徑出發，說明超高性能混凝土為何能以約 150 mm 寬的接縫完成鋼筋非接觸搭接，量化介面應力、收縮約束、搭接長度與鋼纖維用量，再處理介面粗糙化、模板密封與溢流、流度與強度驗收、接縫性能監測、氯離子耐久與交接維修，並以紐約州 2009 年首批現澆 UHPC 接縫與 2013 年 I-81 雪城四座橋的 10 天封路更換為例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the load path through joints between precast deck elements in accelerated bridge construction, explain why ultra-high-performance concrete completes non-contact lap splices in joints about 150 mm wide, quantify interface stress, restrained shrinkage, lap length and steel-fibre content, then cover interface roughening, form sealing and overfill, flow and strength acceptance, joint performance monitoring, chloride durability and handover and repair, using New York's first field-cast UHPC connections in 2009 and the 2013 replacement of four I-81 bridges in Syracuse under 10-day closures.

catalog.title: 預力混凝土孔道灌漿
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
catalog.summary: 從 1985 年威爾斯 Ynys-y-Gwas 橋的突然崩塌與英國 1992 年暫停新建灌漿後拉橋的決定出發，說明灌漿如何同時提供防蝕與握裹，量化鋼腱斷絲的預力損失、高點泌水、氯離子含量與孔道面積比，再處理灌漿壓力與流速、錨頭封護與真空補灌、流度泌水與密度試驗、空洞非破壞檢測、硫酸鹽與氯離子劣化以及灌漿紀錄與風險分級，並以 2000 年夏洛特賽車場人行橋與倫敦漢默史密斯高架橋為鑑。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the sudden 1985 collapse of the Ynys-y-Gwas bridge in Wales and Britain's 1992 halt on new grouted post-tensioned bridges, explain how grout provides both corrosion protection and bond, quantify force loss from broken strands, bleed at high points, chloride content and duct area ratio, then cover grouting pressure and rate, anchorage protection and vacuum regrouting, fluidity, bleed and density testing, non-destructive void detection, sulfate and chloride deterioration and grouting records and risk ranking, learning from the 2000 Charlotte Motor Speedway footbridge and London's Hammersmith Flyover.

catalog.title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
catalog.summary: 從預鑄節塊箱梁外置鋼腱的荷載路徑與冗餘度出發，說明灌漿離析與泌水如何讓鋼絞線在低氯離子下仍然腐蝕斷裂，再處理可更換細部、舊鋼腱去張的能量控制、新鋼腱張拉與伸長量核對、全橋普查、振動與聲射監測，並以美國 Mid-Bay、Ringling 堤道與 Wando River 等橋的鋼腱更換為實例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the load path and redundancy of external tendons in precast segmental box girders, explain how segregated, bleeding grout lets strands corrode and rupture even at low chloride, then cover replaceable detailing, energy control when detensioning the old tendon, force and elongation checks on the new one, network-wide surveys, and vibration and acoustic-emission monitoring, using the tendon replacements at the Mid-Bay, Ringling Causeway and Wando River bridges in the United States.

catalog.title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
catalog.summary: 從焊接細節的應力範圍與 AASHTO 疲勞類別出發，區分載重誘發與變形誘發的疲勞裂縫，以斷裂韌性與 Paris 定律估算臨界尺寸與剩餘壽命，再處理止裂孔、錘擊、螺栓拼接、非破壞檢測、現場應變量測與斷裂關鍵構件的檢查交接，並以 Yellow Mill Pond、Lafayette Street、Hoan 與 I-40 Hernando de Soto 等橋為實例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from stress ranges at welded details and the AASHTO fatigue categories, distinguish load-induced from distortion-induced cracking, estimate critical size and remaining life with fracture toughness and the Paris law, then cover arrest holes, peening, bolted splices, nondestructive testing, field strain measurement and the inspection and handover of fracture-critical members, using the Yellow Mill Pond, Lafayette Street, Hoan and I-40 Hernando de Soto bridges as examples.

catalog.title: 橋梁健康監測感測網
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
catalog.summary: 以香港青馬大橋等橋的風與結構健康監測系統、明尼阿波利斯 I-35W St. Anthony Falls 新橋內建感測器與加州收費橋梁的強震儀為例，說明如何由監測目的決定量測項目與感測器配置，處理感測原理、安裝與供電、資料擷取與時間同步、施工期基準值、模態識別與溫度效應、警戒值與誤報率，以及系統維護與資料交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Using the wind and structural health monitoring system on Hong Kong's Tsing Ma and neighbouring bridges, the built-in sensors of Minneapolis's new I-35W St. Anthony Falls Bridge and the strong-motion instruments on California toll bridges, explain how monitoring objectives set what is measured and where sensors go, then cover sensing principles, installation and power, data acquisition and time synchronisation, construction-stage baselines, modal identification and temperature effects, alert thresholds and false-alarm rates, and system maintenance and data handover.

catalog.title: 橋梁動態荷重試驗
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
catalog.summary: 從車輛動力效應與人群同步振動出發，說明試驗載重與預期反應的計算、儀器與取樣率、趟次矩陣與封橋安全、強迫振動與人群試驗、動力放大與頻率判讀、以試驗修正係數更新評等，以及舒適度改善與基準交接，並以倫敦千禧橋的人群試驗與阻尼改造、雪梨港灣大橋 1932 年的機車載重試驗與 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋為對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from vehicle dynamic effects and crowd lock-in, explain how to compute test loads and expected responses, choose instruments and sampling rates, plan run matrices and safe closures, run forced-vibration and crowd tests, interpret amplification and frequency, update load ratings with test adjustment factors, and handle comfort retrofits and baseline handover, drawing on the crowd tests and damper retrofit of London's Millennium Bridge, the 1932 locomotive load test of Sydney Harbour Bridge and the 1940 Tacoma Narrows Bridge.

catalog.title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
catalog.summary: 從整跨上部結構改由運輸車支承時的彎矩反轉出發，計算動態放大、軸線數量、臨時支撐塔穩定與行駛路徑地盤承載，再處理封閉時段時程、落梁行程與支承對位、移動中的應變與水平監測、地盤預壓試驗，最後檢核既有下部結構、評估用路人成本並交接，案例取自 FHWA 手冊中的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue、荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 與芝加哥 Wells Street 換橋。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the moment reversal when a whole span is carried by transporters, compute dynamic allowance, axle-line count, temporary-tower stability and travel-path bearing, then handle the closure timeline, set-down stroke and bearing alignment, strain and level monitoring during the move and ground proof testing, and finally check the existing substructure, evaluate user costs and hand over, with cases from the FHWA manual: Florida's I-4/Graves Avenue, the Netherlands' Badhoevedorp A4/A5 and Chicago's Wells Street replacements.

catalog.title: 浮吊大型橋段吊裝
catalog.titleEn: Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
catalog.summary: 從岸上預製、水上運送、整段吊裝的工法邏輯出發，計算吊索力、擺動週期與動態放大，再處理吊耳承壓、構件吊裝狀態受力、浮吊錨泊、落位時潮汐與吃水變化，接著以吊鉤荷重與重心量測、天候窗口與預報係數驗證，最後處理吊孔封填、吊耳移除後的疲勞與交接紀錄，並以聯邦大橋的 Svanen 雙體浮吊、舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段與新 Tappan Zee 橋的剪腿式浮吊為案例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the logic of prefabricating on shore, transporting over water and lifting whole segments, compute sling forces, swing periods and dynamic amplification, then handle lug bearing, the lifted-state behaviour of members, crane-barge mooring and tide and draft changes at set-down, verify with hook-load and centre-of-gravity measurements, weather windows and forecast factors, and finally treat lifting-hole sealing, fatigue after lug removal and handover records, with the Svanen catamaran at Confederation Bridge and the shear-leg crane at the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge east span and the new Tappan Zee crossing as cases.

catalog.title: 高層建築核心筒滑模施工
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 滑模把核心筒牆體當成一條不停的生產線：約 1.2 m 高的模板由千斤頂沿爬桿每隔數分鐘上升一小段，下緣出模的混凝土必須已能自立，上方同時綁紮鋼筋、安裝埋件並澆置。本課以 CN Tower、ThyssenKrupp 羅特魏爾試驗塔與亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔為例，說明滑升速度與凝結時間、爬桿挫屈、埋件協調、垂直度與扭轉控制、冷縫與養護、以及竣工紀錄。
catalog.summaryEn: Slipforming turns a core wall into a non-stop production line: forms about 1.2 m high are jacked up rods a small step every few minutes, concrete leaving the bottom edge must already stand on its own, and above it crews fix rebar, set embeds and place concrete at the same time. Using the CN Tower, the ThyssenKrupp test tower in Rottweil and the elevator test tower in Atlanta, the course covers slip rate versus setting time, climbing-rod buckling, embed coordination, verticality and twist control, cold joints and curing, and as-built records.

catalog.title: 高層建築液壓爬模施工
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 液壓自動爬模與滑模不同：每層混凝土澆置後先硬化，再由油壓缸把模板與多層工作平台沿爬升軌道推到上一層，荷載經由預埋錨錐傳入早齡牆體。本課以哈里發塔的 226 組自爬單元與 3 天樓層循環、樂天世界塔的核心筒與巨柱爬模為例，說明循環時程、錨點荷載路徑、油壓機構、模板側壓、平台荷重、爬升停檢點、早齡強度驗收、同步監測、錨孔處理與拆除交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Hydraulic automatic climbing forms differ from slipforms: each lift of concrete hardens first, then hydraulic cylinders push the forms and multi-level working platforms along climbing rails to the next storey, with loads passing through cast-in anchor cones into young walls. Using the 226 self-climbing units and three-day floor cycle at Burj Khalifa and the core and megacolumn climbing forms at Lotte World Tower, the course covers cycle time, the anchor load path, hydraulics, form pressure, platform loads, climbing hold points, early-strength acceptance, synchronisation monitoring, anchor-hole treatment and dismantling handover.

catalog.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
catalog.summary: 以台北 101、哈里發塔與上海中心為例，從外伸臂約束核心轉角的旋轉彈簧模型與單道外伸臂的最佳高度出發，處理巨柱有效長度與樓板支撐力、外伸桁架穿入核心牆的力傳遞，再到差異縮短與延遲鎖定、雙層高桁架的焊接收縮、應變監測回推勁度、阻尼外伸臂，最後是外伸臂樓層的改裝管控與長期徐變監測。
catalog.summaryEn: Using Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa and Shanghai Tower as examples, start from the rotational-spring model of how outriggers restrain core rotation and from the optimum level of a single outrigger, handle mega-column effective length and floor bracing forces and force transfer where outrigger trusses enter core walls, then differential shortening and delayed lock-off, weld shrinkage in two-storey trusses, strain monitoring to back-calculate stiffness and damped outriggers, ending with alteration control on outrigger floors and long-term creep monitoring.

catalog.title: 高層建築斜交網格結構
catalog.summary: 以紐約赫斯特大樓、倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號與廣州國際金融中心為例，從斜柱角度如何在剪力與彎曲勁度之間取捨、樓板如何以環向拉力平衡斜柱外推力出發，處理螺栓與焊接節點、鋼管混凝土斜柱，再到斜柱逐層安裝的穩定與測量控制、節點原型試驗、以實測週期驗證勁度，最後是外露斜柱的耐火防蝕與改裝管控。
catalog.summaryEn: Using the Hearst Tower in New York, 30 St Mary Axe in London and the Guangzhou International Finance Center as examples, start from how the diagonal angle trades shear against bending stiffness and how floors balance the diagonals' outward thrust with hoop tension, handle bolted and welded nodes and concrete-filled tube diagonals, then the stability and survey control of erecting inclined members, node prototype tests and stiffness verification from measured periods, ending with fire and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals and control of alterations.

catalog.title: 束筒高層結構系統
catalog.summary: 以威利斯大樓與 One Magnificent Mile 為例，從框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒如何以內部腹框縮短翼面跨度出發，理解九個 75 英尺方筒的逐段截止，處理預製樹狀柱梁段與沉箱基礎、筒體截止處的力流重分配、混凝土六角束筒，再到邊界層風洞試驗與以柱應變驗證剪力滯後，最後是外殼溫度效應與既有束筒超高層的改造交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Using Willis Tower and One Magnificent Mile, start from shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling shortens flange spans with interior web frames, understand the staged termination of nine 75-foot tubes, handle prefabricated column-tree units and caisson foundations, force redistribution where tubes stop and hexagonal concrete bundles, then boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing and verifying shear lag from column strains, ending with envelope thermal effects and the retrofit and handover of an existing bundled-tube supertall.

catalog.title: 高層建築調諧質量阻尼器
catalog.titleEn: Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings
catalog.summary: 從超高層的橫風向渦流振動與居住舒適度出發，建立主結構模態與擺錘的雙自由度模型，依 Den Hartog 準則決定調頻與阻尼，再處理數百公噸質量塊的吊裝、現場調頻、阻尼器試驗、行程限制與長期監測，最後以台北 101 與上海中心大廈的實例比較油壓與渦電流兩種耗能方式。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from across-wind vortex shedding and occupant comfort in supertall towers, build a two-degree-of-freedom model of the building mode and pendulum, set tuning and damping with the Den Hartog criteria, then handle the erection of a mass of several hundred tonnes, on-site tuning, damper testing, stroke limits and long-term monitoring, comparing hydraulic and eddy-current dissipation through Taipei 101 and Shanghai Tower.
