catalog.title: 液態調諧阻尼器
catalog.summary: 從住宅與辦公塔樓的風致舒適度出發，用線性波浪理論決定淺水槽的晃動頻率與參與水量，用 U 形液柱公式設計液柱阻尼器，再處理閘門與阻尼網的振幅相依阻尼、屋頂水槽結構與分階段注水、以水深現場調頻、縮尺振動台試驗與完工監測，最後談蒸發補水、出水高度與交接，並以 Comcast Center、One Wall Centre 與 One Rincon Hill 的公開資料對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from wind comfort in residential and office towers, use linear wave theory to set the sloshing frequency and participating water of shallow tanks and the U-tube formula to size liquid-column dampers, then handle amplitude-dependent damping from gates and screens, rooftop tank structures and staged filling, field tuning by water depth, scaled shaking-table tests and post-completion monitoring, and finally evaporation, freeboard and handover, compared with public information on Comcast Center, One Wall Centre and One Rincon Hill.

catalog.title: 黏滯阻尼器性能驗證
catalog.summary: 從附加阻尼的性能目標出發，建立 F = C·v^α 的非線性本構與麥斯威爾串聯模型，檢查缸體耐壓與密封，再走過逐件出廠試驗、現場安裝的行程預算與置中、原型試驗的頻率與溫升、完工系統識別，最後談長期抽樣復驗與地震後評估，並以 Torre Mayor、台灣高鐵雲林段高架橋與倫敦千禧橋的公開資料對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from supplemental-damping performance targets, build the nonlinear law F = C·v^α and the Maxwell series model, check cylinder pressure and seals, then work through production testing of every unit, stroke budgets and centring at installation, prototype frequency and temperature-rise tests and post-completion system identification, and finally long-term sample re-testing and post-earthquake assessment, compared with public information on Torre Mayor, the Taiwan High Speed Rail Yunlin viaduct and London's Millennium Bridge.

catalog.title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 超高層核心筒與巨柱的混凝土多以泵送輸送，600 m 的垂直高度本身就產生約 14 MPa 的靜壓，再加上高強度混凝土黏度高造成的管壁摩擦，泵機出口壓力可達 20 至 30 MPa 級。本課以哈里發塔 2008 年 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄、上海中心大廈約 580 m 的泵送、平安金融中心以 C100 泵送至 555.5 m 等案例，說明壓力組成、潤滑層流變、高壓管與接頭、泵機功率、管線固定、開泵與清管、可泵性試驗、溫度與坍流度監測、磨耗檢測與強度追溯。
catalog.summaryEn: Concrete for supertall cores and megacolumns is mostly pumped; a vertical lift of 600 m alone creates about 14 MPa of static head, and wall friction from viscous high-strength mixes pushes pump outlet pressures into the 20 to 30 MPa range. Using Burj Khalifa's 2008 vertical pumping record of 606 m, pumping to about 580 m at Shanghai Tower and C100 concrete pumped to 555.5 m at Ping An Finance Center, the course covers pressure components, lubrication-layer rheology, high-pressure pipes and couplings, pump power, line fixing, start-up and flushing, pumpability testing, temperature and slump-flow monitoring, wear inspection and strength traceability.

catalog.titleEn: Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 超高層的筏基厚達數公尺、一次連續澆置數萬立方公尺，水泥水化放出的熱量幾乎全部困在核心，表面卻持續散熱，造成高溫與內外溫差。本課以上海中心大廈約 6 萬 m³ 的連續澆置、天津高銀金融 117 的 65,000 m³ 筏基與洛杉磯 Wilshire Grand Center 的約 5.5 m 厚筏基為例，說明溫升估算、約束應力、低熱配比、冷卻管、連續供料與分層、保溫養護、熱電偶監測、模型校正、延遲鈣礬石風險與溫控紀錄交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Supertall rafts are several metres thick and placed continuously in tens of thousands of cubic metres; hydration heat is trapped almost entirely in the core while the surfaces keep losing heat, creating high temperatures and core-to-surface differentials. Using Shanghai Tower's continuous pour of about 60,000 m³, the 65,000 m³ raft of Goldin Finance 117 in Tianjin and the raft about 5.5 m thick at Wilshire Grand Center in Los Angeles, the course covers temperature-rise estimates, restraint stresses, low-heat mixes, cooling pipes, continuous supply and layering, insulated curing, thermocouple monitoring, model calibration, delayed ettringite risk and handover of thermal-control records.

catalog.title: 鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗
catalog.titleEn: Welding inspection of major steel joints
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 從巨型梁柱接頭與箱型柱續接的傳力出發，說明 1994 年 Northridge 地震焊接接頭脆斷的教訓、厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂、焊接程序與銲工資格、焊接順序與收縮、品管與品保停留點、超音波檢測幾何、尺寸目視檢查、缺陷修補與焊道紀錄，並以 Alexander L. Kielland 平台、I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋與舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段為實例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from force transfer in mega beam–column joints and box-column splices, explain the lessons of brittle weld fractures in the 1994 Northridge earthquake, lamellar tearing and hydrogen cold cracking in thick plate, welding procedures and welder qualification, weld sequence and shrinkage, quality-control and quality-assurance hold points, ultrasonic testing geometry, dimensional visual inspection, defect repair and weld records, with the Alexander L. Kielland platform, the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge and the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span as examples.

catalog.title: 高強度螺栓預拉力施工
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 從摩擦型接頭的傳力與預拉力對疲勞的作用出發，說明螺栓等級與氫脆、接觸面處理與孔型、密貼與鎖緊順序、轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與直接張力指示墊圈、安裝前驗證與施工後稽核、長期鬆弛與紀錄交接，並以 RCSC 規範 2025 年版撤除校正扳手法、舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋 2013 年錨桿斷裂、1979 年 Kemper Arena 屋頂吊架螺栓失效與雪梨港灣大橋六百萬支鉚釘為對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from force transfer in slip-critical joints and the role of pretension in fatigue, explain bolt grades and hydrogen embrittlement, faying surfaces and hole types, snugging and tightening sequence, turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and direct tension indicators, pre-installation verification and post-installation audits, long-term relaxation and record handover, contrasted with the withdrawal of the calibrated wrench method in the 2025 RCSC Specification, the 2013 anchor-rod fractures on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge, the 1979 Kemper Arena hanger-bolt failure and the six million rivets of Sydney Harbour Bridge.

catalog.title: 組合樓板剪力釘焊接
catalog.titleEn: Stud welding for composite floor systems
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 從組合梁介面的水平剪力流與部分組合出發，說明頭釘強度與壓型鋼板肋的折減、穿板焊接的電流與環境條件、首件 30° 彎曲試驗與外觀檢查、推出試驗求取剪力釘強度，以及火災溫度效應與改修時的紀錄需求，並以 NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓組合樓板的調查、雙子塔以桁架「指節」取得組合作用的樓板，以及英國鋼結構協會對穿板焊接的說明為依據。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from horizontal shear flow and partial composite action at the beam–slab interface, explain headed-stud strength and its reduction in deck ribs, current and site conditions for through-deck welding, first-stud 30° bend tests and visual checks, push-out tests for stud resistance, and fire and thermal effects and record-keeping for alterations, drawing on NIST's investigation of the composite floors of 7 World Trade Center, the Twin Towers' floors made composite by truss knuckles, and steel-industry guidance on through-deck welding.

catalog.title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
catalog.summary: 超高層的柱與核心筒在重力、潛變與收縮下持續縮短，若兩者縮短量不同，樓板會傾斜，連接構件與外伸臂會鎖入附加力，帷幕牆與電梯也會被拉扯。本課從縮短的三個來源與「安裝後縮短」的觀念出發，談構件尺寸、鋼—混凝土混合系統、標高補償、延遲接合時機、振弦式應變計與測量回饋，到非結構構件的容許變形與竣工後的長期追蹤，並以樂天世界塔、哈里發塔與世界貿易中心一號大樓的公開做法為例。
catalog.summaryEn: In a supertall building, columns and cores keep shortening under gravity, creep and shrinkage; when they shorten by different amounts, floors tilt, connecting members and outriggers lock in extra forces, and façades and elevators are strained. Starting from the three sources of shortening and the idea of post-installation shortening, the course covers member size, steel–concrete hybrid systems, level compensation, timing of delayed connections, vibrating-wire gauges and survey feedback, then tolerances of non-structural elements and long-term tracking after completion, illustrated by public practice at Lotte World Tower, Burj Khalifa and One World Trade Center.

catalog.title: 建築施工階段結構分析
catalog.summary: 完工結構的分析假設所有構件同時存在、荷重一次加上，但真實建築是一層層長出來的：混凝土在年輕時就被加載、接頭在不同時間鎖定、支撐被逐步拆除，許多內力在施工中被「鎖入」並留到營運期。本課從一次加載的誤差、施工期風荷載與早齡期材料、接頭狀態與溫差，到由上而下開挖、核心領先、監測回饋、接合前位移監測、鎖入應力與營運中改造，以中央電視台總部、碎片大廈、樂天世界塔與威利斯大樓的公開做法為例。
catalog.summaryEn: Analysis of a completed structure assumes all members exist at once and loads arrive in one step, but real buildings grow floor by floor: concrete is loaded young, joints are locked at different times, shores are removed in stages, and many forces are locked in during construction and remain in service. The course moves from the error of one-step loading, construction-period wind and early-age materials, joint states and temperature differences, to top-down excavation, core lead, monitoring feedback, pre-closure movement monitoring, locked-in stresses and alterations in occupied buildings, drawing on public practice at CCTV Headquarters, The Shard, Lotte World Tower and Willis Tower.

catalog.title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
catalog.summary: 從 Ronan Point、世界貿易中心 7 號大樓與 Champlain Towers South 的教訓出發，建立異常荷載的風險觀念與拆柱後的荷載重分配，學習拉結力法、板柱穿孔剪力與完整性鋼筋、懸鏈作用與接頭轉角，再談施工符合性、子結構試驗與能量法、既有建築腐蝕評估、火災熱膨脹觸發的倒塌，以及使用期間的荷載變更管理與交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the lessons of Ronan Point, World Trade Center 7 and Champlain Towers South, build the risk view of abnormal loads and the load redistribution after column loss, learn the tie-force method, slab–column punching shear and integrity reinforcement, catenary action and connection rotation, then cover construction conformance, subassembly tests and the energy method, corrosion assessment of existing buildings, fire-triggered collapse through thermal expansion, and load-change management and handover in service.

catalog.title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
catalog.summary: 從鹽湖城市郡大樓、舊金山市政府與猶他州議會大廈的隔震改造出發，計算隔震後的週期、位移與扭轉放大，設計鉛心橡膠支承與後拉預力托換梁，再處理切柱頂升的荷載轉移、施工期間的地震風險、原型與出廠試驗、強震監測，最後談性質變化的上下限分析、隔震縫維護與交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the isolation retrofits of the Salt Lake City and County Building, San Francisco City Hall and the Utah State Capitol, compute isolated period, displacement and torsional amplification, design lead-rubber bearings and post-tensioned transfer girders, then handle load transfer by cutting and jacking, earthquake risk during construction, prototype and production tests and strong-motion monitoring, and finally upper- and lower-bound property analysis, moat maintenance and handover.

catalog.title: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 剪力牆是高層與中高層建築最主要的側力抵抗構件，其耐震表現取決於牆端邊界構材的圍束、縱筋續接位置、施工縫處理與混凝土在密集鋼筋中的密實度。本課以哈里發塔的扶壁式核心牆、亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔的滑模核心牆，以及 2011 年基督城 CTV 大樓倒塌後皇家調查委員會的檢討為背景，說明側力分配、邊界構材需求、圍束配筋、續接、鋼筋間距與骨材、澆置振搗、強度驗收、澆置前查驗、震後損傷判讀與開孔變更管控。
catalog.summaryEn: Shear walls are the main lateral-force-resisting members of mid- and high-rise buildings, and their seismic performance depends on confinement of boundary elements, the location of longitudinal splices, treatment of construction joints and the compaction of concrete within dense reinforcement. Against the background of Burj Khalifa's buttressed core walls, the slipformed core walls of the Atlanta elevator test tower and the Royal Commission's review after the 2011 collapse of the CTV Building in Christchurch, the course covers lateral force sharing, boundary-element demand, confinement detailing, splices, bar spacing and aggregate size, placing and vibration, strength acceptance, pre-pour inspection, post-earthquake damage interpretation and control of later openings.

catalog.title: 挫屈束制支撐安裝
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
catalog.summary: 從挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑與層間變位換算核心應變出發，檢查核心、套管與脫層材及節點板的設計，再把重點放在安裝：重力荷載與安裝時機造成的預壓、現場配合誤差與螺栓鎖固，接著談 AISC 341 資格試驗與震後評估、防火與熱膨脹，最後是更換與交接，並以 One Rincon Hill、鹽湖城國際機場與日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐公開資料對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the load path of buckling-restrained braced frames and the conversion of storey drift into core strain, check the core, casing, unbonding layer and gusset design, then focus on installation: preload from gravity loads and installation timing, fit-up misfit and bolt tightening, followed by AISC 341 qualification tests and post-earthquake assessment, fire and thermal expansion, and finally replacement and handover, compared with public information on One Rincon Hill, Salt Lake City International Airport and Nippon Steel Engineering's unbonded brace.

catalog.title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
catalog.summary: 從預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑與自復位原理出發，計算混合預力梁柱接頭的開口、鋼腱應力與軟鋼脫黏長度，設計灌漿套筒續接，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定、樓梯與樓板的支承長度與滑動縫、ACI 374.1 試驗允收與 PRESSS 縮尺試驗，最後談套筒灌漿缺陷檢測與震後預力復驗，並以 The Paramount、PRESSS 試驗建築與基督城地震的公開教訓對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the seismic load path of precast frames and the principle of self-centring, compute gap opening, tendon stress and mild-steel debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned beam–column joints and design grouted sleeve splices, then handle temporary stability during erection, seating length and sliding joints for stairs and floors, ACI 374.1 test acceptance and the PRESSS scaled test, and finally detection of sleeve grouting defects and post-earthquake prestress checks, compared with public lessons from The Paramount, the PRESSS test building and the Christchurch earthquake.

catalog.title: 預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
catalog.summary: 從雙 T 梁斷面與屋頂荷載路徑出發，計算預力反拱與長期撓度、缺口梁端吊筋與水平束制力、翼板連接器的隔板剪力，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定與連接完成、反拱差與屋面排水、放鬆時端部應力與出廠品質、現場載重試驗，最後談屋面防水與連接器腐蝕、改裝開孔與交接，並以美國職業安全衛生署對邁阿密戴德學院停車場與 Montgomery Mall 雙 T 梁事故的調查報告對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the double-tee section and the roof load path, compute prestress camber and long-term deflection, dapped-end hangers and horizontal restraint forces, and diaphragm shear on flange connectors, then handle temporary stability and completed connections during erection, camber differential and roof drainage, end stresses at transfer and plant quality, and in-situ load testing, and finally roof waterproofing and connector corrosion, alterations and handover, compared with OSHA investigation reports on the Miami Dade College garage and Montgomery Mall double-tee incidents.

catalog.title: 大跨度空間桁架提升
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 大跨度屋蓋若在高空逐件安裝，需要大量臨時支撐、高空作業與大型吊車；改在地面組裝後整體提升，能提高品質與安全，但提升狀態下桁架的支承點、受力方向與穩定條件都和使用狀態不同。課程以倫敦希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋、新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的 1,270 t 提升，以及川口衞發展、1984 年首用於神戶世界紀念館的 Pantadome 頂升構法為錨點，說明吊點與吊耳、鋼絞線與千斤頂、同步控制、塔架穩定、試提升、風速停止準則與就位轉換的檢核邏輯。
catalog.summaryEn: Erecting a long-span roof piece by piece at height needs extensive falsework, work at height and large cranes; assembling it at ground level and lifting it whole improves quality and safety, but in the lifting state the truss has different supports, force directions and stability conditions from service. Anchored on the 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5, the 1,270 t lift of the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark and Mamoru Kawaguchi's Pantadome push-up method first used at Kobe's World Memorial Hall in 1984, the course explains the checking logic for lift points and lugs, strands and jacks, synchronised control, tower stability, trial lifts, wind stop criteria and final load transfer.

catalog.title: 張拉膜屋蓋成形
catalog.titleEn: Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 張拉膜沒有抗彎勁度，形狀必須是預應力與邊界共同決定的平衡曲面，因此設計流程從形狀尋找開始，再以膜材雙軸試驗決定勁度與裁片補償，最後在現場展開、吊升並分階段導入預應力。課程以丹佛國際機場 Jeppesen 航廈的雙層 PTFE 屋頂（約 34,800 m² 主屋頂）、吉達哈吉航廈的 210 個錐形膜單元與 Frei Otto 的 1967 年蒙特婁德國館為錨點，說明邊索與膜預應力的關係、積水與雪載、膜材強度折減、補償率誤差、吊升風速、錐形單元頂升、張力量測、顫振、潛變鬆弛與維護交接。
catalog.summaryEn: A tensile membrane has no bending stiffness, so its shape must be an equilibrium surface set by prestress and boundaries; design therefore starts with form finding, then uses biaxial fabric tests to set stiffness and pattern compensation, and finally unfolds, hoists and prestresses the membrane on site in stages. Anchored on the double-layer PTFE roof of Denver International Airport's Jeppesen Terminal (about 34,800 m² of main roof), the 210 conical membrane units of the Hajj Terminal in Jeddah and Frei Otto's 1967 German Pavilion in Montreal, the course covers edge-cable and prestress relations, ponding and snow, fabric strength reduction, compensation errors, hoisting wind limits, jacking of conical units, tension measurement, flutter, creep relaxation and maintenance handover.

catalog.title: 索網屋蓋張拉
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 索網屋蓋在完成張拉之前只是一堆會晃動的鋼索，預拉力與曲率才讓它具有勁度，因此張拉是設計的一部分而不是單純的施工步驟。課程以 1952 年羅利 Dorton 體育館（世界第一座永久性索支承屋頂，約 300 ft 無柱跨度）、1972 年慕尼黑奧運鞍形索網、卡加利 Saddledome 的索承混凝土雙曲面，以及巴西利亞國家體育場的平衡懸吊輪輻式雙層屋頂為錨點，說明預拉勁度、受壓環、索頭錨具、地面組裝與提升張拉、力與幾何控制、頻率法量索、載重試驗、溫度與鬆弛，以及單索更換的檢核邏輯。
catalog.summaryEn: A cable-net roof is only a set of swaying cables until it is tensioned; prestress and curvature give it stiffness, so tensioning is part of the design rather than a mere construction step. Anchored on Raleigh's Dorton Arena of 1952 (the world's first permanent cable-supported roof, about 300 ft clear span), Munich's 1972 Olympic saddle nets, the cable-held concrete saddle of Calgary's Saddledome and the balanced-suspension-wheel double-layer roof of Brasília's National Stadium, the course explains the checking logic for prestress stiffness, compression rings, cable terminations, ground assembly with lift-and-tension, force and geometry control, frequency-based force measurement, load tests, temperature and relaxation, and single-cable replacement.

catalog.title: 可開合體育場屋頂
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 可開合屋頂同時是大跨度鋼結構與一部大型行走機械：固定主結構承受軌道與移動屋面板，轉向架把輪壓傳入軌道梁，驅動與制動在限定風速下讓屋面板同步移動。本課以多倫多 SkyDome（今 Rogers Centre）、亞特蘭大賓士體育場、溫布頓中央球場與福岡巨蛋為例，建立狀態荷載、輪壓、驅動功率、偏斜控制、試運轉與長期維護的工程判斷。
catalog.summaryEn: A retractable roof is both a long-span steel structure and a large travelling machine: the fixed primary structure carries rails and moving panels, bogies deliver wheel loads into rail girders, and drives and brakes move the panels in step below a set wind speed. Using Toronto's SkyDome (now Rogers Centre), Atlanta's Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Wimbledon's Centre Court and Fukuoka Dome, the course builds engineering judgement on state-dependent loads, wheel loads, drive power, skew control, commissioning and long-term maintenance.

catalog.title: 薄殼混凝土屋頂施工
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
catalog.summary: 薄殼混凝土屋頂以數公分厚的雙曲面跨越數十公尺，靠的是形狀讓荷載以薄膜壓力傳遞；它的弱點是挫屈、邊緣彎矩、溫差裂縫與施工幾何誤差。本課從 Candela 的雙曲拋物面、Isler 的倒懸模型殼到蘇黎世聯邦理工學院在 NEST HiLo 的索網織物模板，說明殼形、配筋、模板、澆置脫模、幾何量測與長期維護的工程判斷。
catalog.summaryEn: Thin concrete shells span tens of metres with curved surfaces only a few centimetres thick, because their form lets loads travel as membrane compression; their weak points are buckling, edge bending, thermal cracking and construction geometry errors. From Candela's hyperbolic paraboloids and Isler's inverted hanging-model shells to ETH Zurich's cable-net fabric formwork at NEST HiLo, the course explains engineering judgement on shell form, reinforcement, formwork, casting and decentering, geometry survey and long-term maintenance.

catalog.title: 大型玻璃肋結構安裝
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
catalog.summary: 從全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑出發，把面玻璃視為支承於玻璃肋之間的板，再把玻璃肋當作細長深梁檢核面內應力、撓度與側向扭轉挫屈，說明膠合中間膜、強化與熱浸處理、結構矽利康與埋入式金屬件的設計要點，最後處理長玻璃的運輸翻轉、頂部滑動接頭、實體試驗、熱應力與自爆風險，並以上海陸家嘴、曼谷 Iconsiam 與紐約第五大道蘋果直營店的公開工程資料比較不同做法。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the wind load path through an all-glass façade, treat the face glass as plates spanning between fins and each fin as a slender deep beam checked for in-plane stress, deflection and lateral–torsional buckling, then cover laminated interlayers, toughening and heat soaking, structural silicone and laminated-in metal fittings, and finally long-glass transport and tilting, sliding head joints, physical testing, thermal stress and spontaneous-breakage risk, comparing approaches through public engineering information on Apple Pudong in Shanghai, Apple Iconsiam in Bangkok and Apple Fifth Avenue in New York.

catalog.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
catalog.summary: 從單元板塊的風壓與自重傳遞路徑出發，計算錨件反力、樓板撓度與層間變位對上下單元接縫的需求，說明公母豎框、預埋槽與三向調整錨件的設計，再處理樓層吊運、安裝順序、公差吸收與性能樣品牆的層間位移試驗，最後以斷熱、排水、結露與維護更換完成交接，並以哈里發塔、世界貿易中心一號大樓與碎片大廈的公開資料說明超高層立面的尺度。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from how wind and self-weight travel through a unit, calculate anchor reactions and the demands that slab deflection and interstorey drift place on the stack joint, explain split mullions, cast-in channels and three-way adjustable brackets, then cover floor-by-floor logistics, installation sequence, tolerance absorption and racking tests on the performance mock-up, and close with thermal breaks, drainage, condensation and maintenance, using public information on Burj Khalifa, One World Trade Center and The Shard to show the scale of supertall façades.

catalog.title: 雙層通風幕牆整合
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
catalog.summary: 從雙層通風幕牆的腔體類型與氣候條件出發，建立日射吸熱與通風量決定腔體溫升、煙囪效應決定浮力風量的模型，說明外層玻璃與懸挑托架、檢修走道的結構設計、開口與遮陽的細部，再處理施工整合、控制系統試運轉、樣品牆熱流量測與腔體煙控，最後以清潔、結露與實測能耗完成交接，並以柏林 GSW 總部、溫尼伯曼尼托巴水電大樓與倫敦聖瑪莉斧街 30 號說明不同的腔體策略。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from cavity types and climate, build models in which absorbed solar gain and airflow set cavity temperature rise and the stack effect sets buoyant airflow, explain the structural design of outer glass, cantilever brackets and maintenance walkways and the detailing of openings and shading, then cover construction integration, control commissioning, mock-up heat-flow measurement and smoke control in the cavity, and close with cleaning, condensation and measured energy at handover, comparing cavity strategies at the GSW headquarters in Berlin, Manitoba Hydro Place in Winnipeg and 30 St Mary Axe in London.

catalog.title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
catalog.summary: 從雨水穿透外牆的驅動力與風壓換算出發，說明壓力等化雨幕、空氣屏障與接縫毛細作用的原理，再把設計風壓轉成 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列試驗的壓力與允收值，處理樣品牆試驗、施工中現場抽驗與 AAMA 501.2 噴水試驗的時程，最後以漏水診斷、事件後複驗與交接紀錄收尾，並以台北 101、麻省理工學院 Stata 中心與英屬哥倫比亞漏水公寓危機說明試驗與設計失誤的代價。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the forces that drive rain through a façade and the conversion of wind pressure, explain pressure-equalised rainscreens, air barriers and capillarity at joints, then turn design pressure into the test pressures and acceptance values of ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, covering mock-up testing, field sampling during installation and the time budget of AAMA 501.2 hose testing, and close with leak diagnosis, post-event re-testing and handover records, using Taipei 101, MIT's Stata Center and the British Columbia leaky-condo crisis to show what testing and design errors cost.

catalog.title: 高層建築消防分區設計
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
catalog.summary: 從防火區劃的目的與火載量出發，比較灑水系統與區劃的分工，計算標準火災溫度與時間等效、防火門縫隙的漏煙、樓板邊緣縫隙的等效開口，再處理施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性、耐火試驗、樓梯加壓驗收、區劃失效時的結構臨界溫度，最後談使用管理與交接，並以高雄城中城大樓、倫敦 Grenfell Tower 與費城 One Meridian Plaza 的教訓對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from the purpose of compartmentation and fire load, compare the roles of sprinklers and compartments, compute standard-fire temperatures and time equivalence, smoke leakage through fire-door gaps and the equivalent opening of slab-edge gaps, then cover compartment integrity during construction and fit-out, fire-resistance testing, stair-pressurisation acceptance and structural critical temperatures when compartments fail, and finally management in use and handover, compared with lessons from Kaohsiung's Cheng Chung Cheng Building, London's Grenfell Tower and Philadelphia's One Meridian Plaza.

catalog.title: 超高層電梯分區與調度
catalog.titleEn: Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
catalog.summary: 從上行尖峰人口與五分鐘運輸能力出發，說明超高層為何以穿梭電梯、空中大廳與疊用井道分段服務，再處理數百公尺行程的鋼索自重與曳引、超高速車廂的耳壓與振動、核心筒縮短下的導軌安裝、目的樓層派梯與往返時間計算，最後談鋼索擺動、維護更新與緊急運轉，並以哈里發塔、上海中心大廈與台北 101 的公開資料對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from up-peak population and five-minute handling capacity, explain why supertall towers serve their floors in tiers with shuttles, sky lobbies and stacked shafts, then handle rope self-weight and traction over hundreds of metres, ear pressure and vibration in ultra-high-speed cars, rail installation on a shortening core, destination dispatch and round-trip-time calculation, and finally rope sway, maintenance, modernisation and emergency operation, compared with public data from Burj Khalifa, Shanghai Tower and Taipei 101.

catalog.title: 鋼構耐火被覆施工
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
catalog.summary: 從鋼材在火害中的強度折減與臨界溫度出發，建立斷面係數與被覆厚度的熱傳關係，比較噴覆型防火材料（SFRM）與膨脹型防火塗料的材料機制、施工環境與交叉作業損傷，再以 ASTM E605／E736 現場抽驗、耐火試驗登錄與約束條件判讀完成驗收，並以世界貿易中心、紐約時報大樓與馬德里溫莎大樓說明厚度、黏結與改修過渡期的風險。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from steel strength loss and critical temperature in fire, build the heat-transfer link between section factor and protection thickness, compare the mechanisms, site conditions and trade damage of sprayed fire-resistive materials (SFRM) and intumescent coatings, then close acceptance with ASTM E605/E736 field sampling, fire-test listings and restraint classification, using the World Trade Center, the New York Times Building and the Windsor Building in Madrid to show the risks of thin spots, weak bond and half-finished retrofits.

catalog.title: 跨層轉換桁架施工
catalog.summary: 當上部樓層的柱位與下部不同，例如住宅柱網落在開闊的辦公或大廳之上，或周邊柱要集中到少數巨柱，就需要跨越一到數層樓高的轉換桁架。轉換桁架承受多層樓的集中荷重，構件厚重、接頭複雜，而且在施工中必須先完成並具足夠勁度，上方樓層才能開始施作。本課以碎片大廈的費氏轉換、樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架與吊掛樓層、赫斯特大樓的超級斜撐和威利斯大樓底座改造的轉換梁為例，談荷重路徑、吊掛、厚板焊接、接頭、整體提升、預拱與卸撐、超音波檢驗、卸載監測、防火與交接。
catalog.summaryEn: When upper columns do not line up with those below, for example a residential grid over open offices or a lobby, or perimeter columns gathered onto a few mega-columns, transfer trusses one to several storeys deep are needed. They carry concentrated loads from many floors, so members are heavy and joints complex, and during construction they must be complete and stiff before the floors above can proceed. Using the Vierendeel transfers of The Shard, the belt trusses and hung floors of Lotte World Tower, the super-diagonals of the Hearst Tower and the transfer girders of the Willis Tower base repositioning, the course covers load paths, hanging, thick-plate welding, joints, lifting, camber and de-propping, ultrasonic testing, unloading monitoring, fire protection and handover.

catalog.title: 清水混凝土模板與澆置
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 清水混凝土的表面就是建築完成面，不能事後粉刷遮蓋，因此模板分割、繫桿孔排列、面板材料、脫模劑、配比與骨材一致性、澆置速度與振搗、樣板牆與驗收距離都必須在施工前定案。本課以安藤忠雄的光之教會與路易斯．康的沙克研究所為例，並以 ACI 347.3R 的成形面等級 CSC1 至 CSC4 與 ACI 301 第 6 節建築混凝土為框架，說明清水混凝土從設計意圖到長期維護的工程判斷。
catalog.summaryEn: In exposed architectural concrete the surface is the finished building face and cannot be covered later, so panel layout, tie-hole pattern, facing material, release agent, mix and aggregate consistency, placing rate and vibration, mock-ups and viewing distance must all be settled before casting. Using Tadao Ando's Church of the Light and Louis Kahn's Salk Institute, framed by the ACI 347.3R formed-surface categories CSC1 to CSC4 and ACI 301 Section 6 Architectural Concrete, the course explains engineering judgement from design intent to long-term maintenance.

catalog.title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
catalog.summary: 從樓層高度預算與管線空間出發，說明聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器如何讓各專業模型可比對，再處理硬碰撞與軟碰撞規則、模型發展程度、BCF 議題追蹤與區域簽認、4D 時空碰撞、誤報分組與模型品質、現場放樣公差，以及版本控制與資產資訊交接，並以 Crossrail 與巴黎路易威登基金會的公開資料對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from storey-height budgets and service space, explain how federated models, shared coordinates and information containers make discipline models comparable, then cover hard and clearance clash rules, level of development, BCF issue tracking and area sign-off, 4D space–time clashes, grouping of false positives and model quality, site set-out tolerances, version control and asset-information handover, compared with public material from Crossrail and the Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris.

catalog.title: 施工測量控制網
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
catalog.summary: 從控制網層級與精度預算出發，說明投影比例因子、觀測墩與強制對心、全測站與 GNSS 的精度規格與 ISO 17123 現場檢定，再處理導線與最小二乘平差、高層建築軸線垂直傳遞、GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算、長隧道貫通誤差，以及控制網複測、參考框架與交接紀錄，並以戈達基線隧道、英法海底隧道與 Crossrail 的公開資料對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from network hierarchy and accuracy budgets, explain projection scale factors, pillars and forced centring, total-station and GNSS specifications with ISO 17123 field tests, then traverses and least-squares adjustment, vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings, static GNSS and height conversion, long-tunnel breakthrough error, and finally network re-survey, reference frames and handover records, compared with public data from the Gotthard Base Tunnel, the Channel Tunnel and Crossrail.

catalog.subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
catalog.subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
catalog.summary: 從竣工偏差與量測不確定度出發，說明 USIBD LOA 的量測與表現精度、掃描儀測距誤差與點間距、標靶控制與配準，再處理依施工節點排定掃描、樓板平整度、點雲與模型偏差分析、獨立檢核點與 ISO 17123-9 檢定，最後談基準掃描、變形比對與 E57 資料交接，並以巴黎聖母院與烏干達卡蘇比王陵的掃描紀錄支持重建為例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from as-built deviation and measurement uncertainty, explain measured and represented accuracy under the USIBD LOA specification, scanner ranging errors and point spacing, target control and registration, then scheduling scans at construction milestones, slab flatness, cloud-to-model deviation analysis, independent check points and ISO 17123-9 testing, and finally baseline scans, change detection and E57 data handover, using the scan records that supported rebuilding at Notre-Dame de Paris and the Kasubi Tombs in Uganda.

catalog.titleEn: Protective coating of large steel structures
catalog.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
catalog.summary: 從大氣腐蝕環境與 ISO 12944 腐蝕性分級出發，說明鋅底漆、中塗與面漆的防蝕機制、噴砂清潔度與錨紋、露點與施工環境、構件細部與邊緣膜厚、濕膜與乾膜厚度驗收、附著力檢測、劣化分級與維護策略，並以舊金山金門大橋的持續修補、蘇格蘭福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗與艾菲爾鐵塔每約七年一次的重塗為實例。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from atmospheric corrosivity and the ISO 12944 categories, explain how zinc primers, intermediate coats and topcoats protect steel, then cover blast-cleaning grade and surface profile, dew point and site conditions, detailing and edge film build, wet- and dry-film thickness acceptance, adhesion testing, degradation rating and maintenance strategy, using the continuous touch-up of San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge, the first full repaint of Scotland's Forth Bridge and the roughly seven-yearly repainting of the Eiffel Tower.

catalog.title: 建築模組化吊裝與接合

catalog.summary: 從體積模組的角柱荷載路徑與雙層樓板出發，說明模組間繫結與防連續倒塌、角部接頭與螺栓接合、吊點與吊裝框，再處理起重機選型與風速限制、堆疊公差與墊片、工廠出廠檢驗、現場接頭與防火防水檢查，最後談模組間空腔的耐久與模組履歷交接，並以新加坡 The Clement Canopy、紐約 461 Dean Street 與蒙特婁 Habitat 67 對照。
catalog.summaryEn: Starting from corner-post load paths and double floors in volumetric modules, explain inter-module ties and progressive-collapse resistance, corner joints and bolting, lift points and lifting frames, then crane selection and wind limits, stacking tolerances and shims, factory release inspection, site joint, fire-stopping and waterproofing checks, and finally durability of inter-module cavities and module-record handover, compared with The Clement Canopy in Singapore, 461 Dean Street in New York and Habitat 67 in Montreal.

catalog.title: 勒奇山基線隧道
catalog.summary: 勒奇山案例的核心不是單純延長隧道，而是已營運路線如何面對分期建造留下的容量與介面限制。BLS公開資料將其描述為約35公里的基線隧道；本課把未裝設段、單線衝突、維修窗口、出水與施工隔離分開，逐步建立可供營運和擴建共同審查的證據鏈。
catalog.summaryEn: The Lotschberg case concerns the capacity and interfaces left by staged construction rather than length alone. BLS describes an approximately 35 km base tunnel. This course separates unfinished bore sections, single-track conflicts, maintenance windows, water conditions and construction isolation, building an evidence chain that operations and expansion teams can review together.

catalog.title: 切內里基線隧道
catalog.summary: 切內里是瑞士新阿爾卑斯鐵路線的南段關鍵，官方資料列長15.4公里並於2020年底全面營運。本課由縱坡與列車需求出發，連接施工物流、軌道基準、隧道氣動和設備交付；學員須解釋土建完成之後仍有哪些測試才能支持完整鐵路服務。
catalog.summaryEn: Ceneri is a southern link of the Swiss new transalpine railway, officially described as 15.4 km and fully operational at the end of 2020. Starting with gradient and train demand, this course connects construction logistics, track reference systems, tunnel aerodynamics and equipment handover to the evidence needed beyond civil completion.

catalog.title: 青函隧道
catalog.summary: 青函隧道把本州與北海道鐵路相連，JR北海道公開資料列總長53.85公里並於1988年開始營業。本課以海底地質預報、灌漿及水壓管理建立施工到維護的連續視角，再討論軌道、氣動、救援及設備可用性；所有計算均另列假設，不把公開總長當成每個模型的輸入。
catalog.summaryEn: Seikan connects the railways of Honshu and Hokkaido; JR Hokkaido reports a total length of 53.85 km and service beginning in 1988. This course links subsea forecasting, grouting and pressure management across construction and maintenance, then examines track, aerodynamics, rescue and availability. Numerical assumptions remain separate from published dimensions.

catalog.title: 費馬恩海峽沉管隧道
catalog.summary: 費馬恩海峽的官方工程頁列18公里沉管隧道，並記載2020年開始施工。本課以跨國道路鐵路共同走廊為背景，逐步檢查箱體量產、重量帳、海床支承、止水接頭和設備交付。未來營運效益與施工進度分開表述，不把建設中的設施描述為已完成營運。
catalog.summaryEn: The official Fehmarnbelt project page describes an 18 km immersed tunnel and construction beginning in 2020. Using a cross-border road and rail corridor, this course examines element production, mass balance, seabed support, sealing and equipment handover. Future service benefits remain separate from construction progress; the facility is not described as already operational.

catalog.title: 馬爾馬拉海底隧道
catalog.summary: 馬爾馬拉跨越博斯普魯斯海峽，承包商資料列沉管段1387公尺，這不是整個鐵路計畫的長度。2013年的通車背景提供都市交通與海底工程的交會案例。本課從管節浮運、基床與接頭開始，再串接鑽掘段、軌道和救援系統，強調不同結構交界的變形相容。
catalog.summaryEn: Marmaray crosses the Bosphorus; contractor records identify a 1387 m immersed section, distinct from the overall railway programme. Its 2013 opening links urban transport and subsea engineering. The course follows flotation, bedding and joints into bored-tunnel transitions, track and rescue systems, emphasising compatible deformation between different structural forms.

catalog.title: 歐亞海底公路隧道
catalog.summary: 歐亞隧道官方將計畫分為14.6公里走廊及其中5.4公里隧道與連接段，2016年開始服務。本課集中雙層道路圓形隧道：先檢查外水壓與襯砌，再分開樓板受力、通風、行車視覺及撤離；所有斷面尺寸及荷載算例均屬教學假設，不能當成實際設計值。
catalog.summaryEn: The operator distinguishes a 14.6 km corridor from its 5.4 km tunnel-and-connection section and records service beginning in 2016. This course focuses on a circular tunnel with a double-deck roadway, linking external pressure and lining to deck loads, ventilation, driver vision and evacuation. All numerical section dimensions and loads are teaching assumptions.

catalog.title: 東京灣跨海公路隧道
catalog.summary: 東京灣跨海公路結合海底隧道、人工島與橋梁，大林組工程史列整體道路15.1公里及1997年施工標竣工。本課把整體走廊與承包商施工範圍分開，聚焦人工島支承、地下接合、環片與止水、通風和鹽害；不把某一標段紀錄泛化為整個工程所有部位的參數。
catalog.summaryEn: The Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line combines a subsea tunnel, artificial islands and a bridge. Obayashi records a 15.1 km road corridor and completion of its contract in 1997. The course separates corridor and contract scope, focusing on island support, underground connections, segments, sealing, ventilation and marine deterioration without generalising one contract to every structure.

catalog.title: 拉爾達隧道
catalog.summary: 拉爾達隧道官方列長24.5公里，於2000年11月開通；同一官方頁也說明後續更新工程。本課將原始營運與更新情境分開，從長距離行車視覺、岩體應力、通風及水量出發，追蹤夜間工程窗口和恢復營運的證據需求，避免以景觀照明取代完整系統評估。
catalog.summaryEn: The road authority reports Laerdal as 24.5 km long and opened in November 2000, while also describing later upgrades. This course separates original service from renewal scenarios, following driver vision, rock stress, ventilation and water into night-work windows and evidence for restoring service. Decorative lighting is not treated as a substitute for system assessment.

catalog.title: 聖哥達公路隧道
catalog.summary: 聖哥達公路隧道自1980年營運，瑞士公路主管機關說明第二孔16.9公里路線用於支持原孔整修，並強調計畫不增加交通容量。本課由這個限制出發，分析雙孔隔離、共用服務坑、岩體擾動和分期切換，將新增土建空間與營運容量清楚區分。
catalog.summaryEn: Gotthard Road Tunnel has operated since 1980. FEDRO describes a 16.9 km second-tube alignment supporting refurbishment of the first tube without increasing traffic capacity. Starting from that constraint, this course examines bore isolation, shared service infrastructure, rock disturbance and staged transfer, distinguishing new civil space from operational capacity.

catalog.title: 聖伯納山隧道
catalog.summary: 聖伯納山隧道營運者列長5798公尺，並說明兩端高山入口與全天有人值守的控制室。1964年開通的背景使其適合學習既有公路隧道長期更新。本課將洞口氣候、雙向車流、通風、耐久及跨境資訊交接串成完整工程問題，避免把洞內性能與引道服務切割。
catalog.summaryEn: The operator describes a 5798 m tunnel with high-altitude portals and continuously staffed control rooms at both ends. Its 1964 opening provides a setting for long-term renewal of an existing road tunnel. The course connects portal climate, bidirectional traffic, ventilation, durability and cross-border information handover rather than isolating tunnel performance from approach service.

catalog.title: 蒙布朗隧道
catalog.summary: 蒙布朗隧道連接法國與義大利，營運機構列長11.6公里並記錄1965年開通。本課以長公路的系統思考為主軸，分別研究通風網路、受熱材料、事故偵知、人的反應、設備冗餘及整修交付。歷史事件只用核對過的年代，假想事故條件不被包裝為原事故重建。
catalog.summaryEn: Mont Blanc Tunnel connects France and Italy; its operator reports 11.6 km and opening in 1965. This course uses a systems perspective on ventilation networks, heated materials, detection, human response, redundancy and refurbishment handover. Historical dates follow checked records, while hypothetical incident conditions are not presented as reconstruction of an actual accident.

catalog.title: 弗雷瑞斯公路隧道
catalog.summary: 法國交通主管機關列弗雷瑞斯原隧道12.87公里、1980年營運，並於2025年公告第二孔開通活動。本課不把原始單孔狀態當成永久現況，而以新舊孔轉換為主軸，研究重車交通、岩體、通風隔離、跨孔救援與設備版本，建立分階段可驗證的營運模型。
catalog.summaryEn: The French transport ministry records the original Frejus tunnel as 12.87 km, in service from 1980, and announced the second-tube opening event in 2025. The course does not treat the original single-bore arrangement as permanent. It studies staged transfer, freight traffic, rock behaviour, airflow isolation, cross-bore rescue and equipment revisions.

catalog.title: 布倫納基線隧道
catalog.summary: 布倫納官方區分55公里基線隧道與包含既有繞行連接的64公里地下路線，並說明下方先進坑的地質調查和未來維護用途。本課由這個三孔系統出發，分析探查更新、多工作面物流、岩體水壓、控制網與軌道需求；各標段里程碑不被誤寫為全工程完工。
catalog.summaryEn: BBT distinguishes the 55 km base tunnel from a 64 km linked underground route including the existing bypass and describes the lower exploratory gallery. This course follows that three-tunnel system through geological updates, multi-heading logistics, rock and water response, survey control and railway needs. Lot milestones are not presented as whole-project completion.

catalog.title: 新武界引水隧道
catalog.summary: 台電典藏說明新武界及栗栖溪引水工程的規劃與施工，列16.5公里引水範圍及其中6.5公里TBM中段，記錄2002年該掘進段貫通。本課把土木、地質與水力目的串接，研究水路能量、探查代表性、支護和施工物流；這些尺度不被混寫成單一孔全長或發電容量。
catalog.summaryEn: Taipower describes planning and construction for New Wujie and Lixi conveyance, including a 16.5 km scope and a 6.5 km TBM middle section that broke through in 2002. This course connects civil, geological and hydraulic purposes through energy, investigation, support and logistics, without confusing those scopes with one bore length or generating capacity.

catalog.title: 蘇花改觀音隧道
catalog.summary: 公路機關列觀音隧道約7.9公里、雙孔單向配置，並記錄利用舊北迴隧道增加施工工作面。本課從這項既有設施再利用出發，分析地質弱帶、地下水、控制網、施工交通與通風設備介面；貫通和2020年蘇花改全線通車是不同事件，課程不把兩者混為一談。
catalog.summaryEn: The highway authority describes Guanyin as approximately 7.9 km with twin directional bores and reuse of an old railway tunnel to create working faces. This course follows weak ground, groundwater, survey, construction traffic and ventilation interfaces. Breakthrough and the 2020 opening of the full Suhua improvement corridor remain distinct events.

catalog.title: 港珠澳大橋海底隧道
catalog.summary: 香港政府工程頁把港珠澳主橋分為約23公里海上高架及約7公里隧道段，並說明外海沉管浮運落底的環境挑戰。本課集中隧道和人工島介面，循序分析箱體框架、浮力、基床、止水、測量及耐久；主橋、整體跨海計畫和沉管段的尺度各自保留原計量邊界。
catalog.summaryEn: The Hong Kong government separates the main crossing into about 23 km of viaduct and 7 km of tunnel and describes open-sea immersion challenges. This course focuses on tunnel-island interfaces through box-frame action, buoyancy, bedding, seals, surveying and durability. Main-crossing, whole-programme and immersed-section dimensions retain their distinct measurement boundaries.

catalog.title: 獅子洋隧道
catalog.summary: 國家鐵路局公開技術資料列獅子洋隧道10.8公里、雙孔單線，並記錄2011年12月通車及軟土、土岩複合與岩層的變化。本課從地層切換到結構和軌道平順性，串接長距離盾構、接合測量、列車氣動及救援；公開設計數字與本課假想模型分開呈現。
catalog.summaryEn: The National Railway Administration records Shiziyang as 10.8 km with twin single-track bores, opening in December 2011 through soft soil, mixed and rock strata. This course links ground transitions to structural and track geometry, long shield drives, connection surveys, train aerodynamics and rescue, keeping published design context separate from teaching calculations.

catalog.title: 關角隧道
catalog.summary: 中國政府公開記錄新關角隧道32.645公里及2014年4月雙線正洞貫通，這個事件不是通車日期。本課從高原長距離施工出發，研究弱帶支護、地下水、通風密度修正、多工作面物流與控制網。所有空氣密度及機具數字明列為假想條件，不代替高海拔現地測量。
catalog.summaryEn: Government records identify New Guanjiao as 32.645 km and both main bores breaking through in April 2014, distinct from opening to traffic. This course studies plateau construction through weak-zone support, water, ventilation-density correction, multi-heading logistics and survey. Air density and equipment values are hypothetical and do not replace high-altitude measurements.

catalog.title: 秦嶺終南山公路隧道
catalog.summary: 陝西交通官方年鑑附錄記錄秦嶺終南山公路隧道18.02公里及2007年1月20日通車。本課將長公路的視覺環境、豎井風路、岩體應力、水壓及設備可靠度整合，要求學員區分舒適感與可量測的障礙辨識。教學通風與照明參數不聲稱是本工程的營運設定。
catalog.summaryEn: The Shaanxi transport yearbook appendix records an 18.02 km tunnel and opening on 20 January 2007. This course integrates visual environment, shaft airflow, rock stress, water pressure and reliability, distinguishing perceived comfort from measurable obstacle detection. Teaching ventilation and lighting parameters are not represented as the project operating settings.

catalog.title: 挪威里菲爾克隧道
catalog.summary: 挪威公路管理局2019年開通紀錄列里菲爾克隧道14.4公里、最低點在海面下292公尺。本課把幾何深度與測壓水頭分開，再研究裂隙封水、支護、低點集水、供電、坡道行車與跨孔撤離；不把海面下深度直接當成所有岩體孔壓或襯砌設計壓力。
catalog.summaryEn: The Norwegian road authority records Ryfylke opening in 2019, at 14.4 km with a low point 292 m below sea level. This course distinguishes geometric depth from piezometric head, then examines fracture sealing, support, low-point drainage, power, road gradients and cross-bore evacuation without treating depth as universal pore or lining pressure.

catalog.title: 首都圈外郭放水路
catalog.titleEn: Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel
catalog.summary: 首都圈外郭放水路由入流設施、地下水路、調壓水槽與泵站共同減少洪水影響，官方圖列水路6.3公里。2002年先行運用的是部分3.3公里區間，工程期至2006年。本課以水量、能量及水位基準串接全系統，避免把地下河道誤當道路隧道或將局部算例當完整洪水演算。
catalog.summaryEn: The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel combines intakes, a 6.3 km underground waterway, a pressure-control tank and pumps. Interim use in 2002 covered a 3.3 km portion; construction continued to 2006. This course connects water balance, energy and level datum without treating the facility as a road or a local calculation as full flood routing.

catalog.title: 新加坡裕廊岩洞
catalog.summary: JTC公開介紹裕廊岩洞可儲存147萬立方公尺液態碳氫產品，並將地下深度與海床下深度分開；2014年開幕有總理公署紀錄。本課從土地介面、岩體節理與支護開始，進入水力封存、產品庫存及監測交付。幾何面積、局部壓差和假想庫存都不等於實際土地效益或操作上限。

catalog.title: 雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工
catalog.summary: 雙護盾可讓切削與管片組裝在不同機構上進行，但並行能力依賴岩壁提供可靠反力、伸縮行程和後勤同步。本課由接觸承壓、軸向推力、循環時間進到擠壓岩與偏轉判讀，將設備能力、地層限制及觀測證據分開列帳。所有數字為教學假設，結論是辨識需要停點審查的條件，不是掘進機操作參數。
catalog.summaryEn: A double shield can separate excavation from segment assembly, but concurrent work depends on a reliable rock reaction, available telescopic travel and synchronized logistics. This course follows contact stress, axial thrust and cycle time into squeezing-ground and steering interpretations. Machine capability, ground limitations and observed evidence are recorded separately. All numerical inputs are teaching assumptions; the outcome identifies conditions requiring engineering review rather than machine operating parameters.

catalog.title: 敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐
catalog.titleEn: Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs
catalog.summary: 敞開式硬岩掘進機依靠撐靴傳遞反力，刀盤後方的岩面可被觀測，但暴露並不等於穩定。本課將岩塊幾何、未支護距離、噴層與錨栓的作用分開建模，再連接收斂、超挖、出碴與資料交接。課程中的梁、重量及時間公式是明示邊界的教學模型，不能據此決定現場進入條件或支護間距。
catalog.summaryEn: An open hard-rock TBM reacts through grippers and leaves rock behind the cutterhead available for observation, but exposure is not evidence of stability. This course separates block geometry, unsupported distance, sprayed lining and bolt action, then connects convergence, overbreak, muck handling and handover. Beam, weight and time relations have explicit teaching boundaries; they cannot determine field access conditions or support spacing.

catalog.title: 隧道分部開挖與支撐
catalog.summary: 分部開挖讓土岩的卸載、變形與支護成形交錯發生，最終斷面強度不能單獨說明施工期表現。本課以簡化反力曲線建立概念，再逐項檢視開挖面分割、早齡材料、仰拱閉合、收斂與防水介面。學員需用量測檢查每一個模型的邊界，將適配曲線、工程判斷及正式核准清楚區分。
catalog.summaryEn: Sequential excavation interleaves unloading, ground movement and support formation, so final-section strength alone cannot explain construction-stage behavior. The course begins with simplified reaction curves and then examines face subdivision, young materials, invert closure, convergence and waterproofing interfaces. Learners test each model boundary against observations and distinguish curve fitting, engineering judgment and formal authorization.

catalog.title: 隧道台階法施工
catalog.summary: 台階法把上半斷面、下半斷面與仰拱分階段形成，各階段的支承位置和自由邊界都會改變。本課追蹤拱腳承載、保留核心、左右開挖與閉合距離的互相影響，再以幾何、物料、收斂及排水資料進行核對。所有算例服務於辨識荷載轉移與資料限制，不指定實際台階長度、開挖步距或拆除程序。
catalog.summaryEn: Bench excavation forms the upper section, lower section and invert in stages, changing support locations and free boundaries along the way. The course follows arch-foot bearing, retained core, left-right excavation and closure distance, checking their interaction through geometry, quantities, convergence and drainage evidence. Calculations identify load transfer and data limitations; they do not prescribe actual bench lengths, excavation increments or removal procedures.

catalog.title: 大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法
catalog.summary: 大斷面側導坑把開挖空間分割成較小區域，但暫時中隔牆及其連接會形成施工期特有的受力系統。本課比較跨度、偏載、牆體剛度與拆除前後的荷載分配，再用測量誤差、階段模型與防水交接檢查推論。課堂的梁、彈簧和壓力算例均不提供拆牆順序或安全許可，學員需辨識何種證據必須由設計者核准。
catalog.summaryEn: Side drifts divide a large excavation into smaller regions, while temporary walls and their connections create a construction-specific structural system. This course compares spans, eccentric loading, wall stiffness and load sharing before and after removal, then checks interpretations through survey uncertainty, staged models and waterproofing handover. Beam, spring and pressure examples prescribe neither a removal sequence nor permission; learners identify evidence requiring designer approval.

catalog.title: 隧道噴射混凝土支護
catalog.summary: 本課以以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護為主線，從薄殼受力與岩面接觸與早齡強度與卸載時序建立系統邊界，再把鋼筋網背後的陰影區、芯樣方向與強度換算連到分區品質與交接證據。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness. It begins with Shell action and rock contact and Early strength and unloading sequence, links Shadows behind reinforcement mesh and Core orientation and strength interpretation, and ends with Zoned quality and handover evidence. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗
catalog.summary: 本課以以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土為主線，從裂後承載與纖維橋接與力位移曲線的能量積分建立系統邊界，再把拔出功與界面滑移、荷重位移同步與零點連到性能規格與試法交接。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction. It begins with Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging and Energy integration of force-displacement curves, links Pullout work and interface slip and Force-displacement synchronization and zero, and ends with Performance specifications and method handover. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
catalog.summary: 本課以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為主線，從岩楔荷重與岩栓方向與鋼材屈服與有效面積建立系統邊界，再把自由段伸長與系統柔度、持載位移與時間效應連到試驗代表性與補強決策。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer. It begins with Wedge weight and bolt direction and Steel yielding and effective area, links Free-length extension and system compliance and Hold movement and time effects, and ends with Representativeness and reinforcement decisions. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架
catalog.summary: 本課以把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統為主線，從榀距與分擔寬度與軸力偏心與彎矩建立系統邊界，再把接頭滑移與力線連續、複合噴層與變形相容連到隱蔽工程與交接追溯。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system. It begins with Rib spacing and tributary width and Axial eccentricity and bending, links Joint slip and force continuity and Composite shotcrete and compatibility, and ends with Concealed works and handover traceability. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 隧道管棚超前支護
catalog.summary: 本課以用縱向跨距、搭接與鑽孔幾何檢核管棚超前支護為主線，從縱向橋接與反力路徑與鋼管截面與抗彎剛度建立系統邊界，再把鑽孔傾角與端部偏位、地層彈簧與支承剛度連到支護界面與撤除判斷。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on check pipe umbrellas through longitudinal spans, overlap and bore geometry. It begins with Longitudinal bridging and reactions and Pipe section and flexural stiffness, links Bore inclination and end offset and Ground springs and restraint stiffness, and ends with Support interfaces and transfer decisions. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿
catalog.summary: 本課以以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強為主線，從掌子面擠出與地層核心與補強密度與非均勻分擔建立系統邊界，再把開挖進尺與保留長度、施工時間與黏結成熟連到面補強與周邊支護協調。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length. It begins with Face extrusion and ground core and Reinforcement density and unequal sharing, links Advance and retained reinforcement and Construction time and bond maturity, and ends with Face reinforcement and peripheral support. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 隧道防水膜鋪設
catalog.summary: 本課以以水壓邊界、焊縫與分區連續性驗證隧道防水膜為主線，從水頭與結構承壓邊界與基面平整與膜材跨空建立系統邊界，再把雙焊道試驗與溫度修正、穿透構件與接縫變形連到耐久相容與維護交接。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on verify tunnel membranes through pressure boundaries, seams and compartment continuity. It begins with Head and structural pressure boundary and Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging, links Dual-seam tests and temperature effects and Penetrations and joint movement, and ends with Durability compatibility and handover. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 隧道二次襯砌台車施工
catalog.titleEn: Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages
catalog.summary: 本課以協調台車定位、新拌混凝土壓力與襯砌成形證據為主線，從淨空與襯砌厚度與新拌混凝土側壓建立系統邊界，再把不對稱壓力與上浮、早齡拆模與支承轉換連到台車循環與品質追溯。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on coordinate carriage position, fresh-concrete pressure and lining geometry evidence. It begins with Clearance and lining thickness and Fresh-concrete lateral pressure, links Asymmetric pressure and uplift and Early stripping and support transfer, and ends with Carriage cycles and quality traceability. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 隧道仰拱閉合施工
catalog.summary: 本課以以閉合環、接頭相容與基底反力解析隧道仰拱為主線，從閉合環與環向力與仰拱曲率與力線建立系統邊界，再把閉合距離與時間效應、地下水浮力與排水狀態連到永久環與維護交接。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on analyze tunnel inverts through ring closure, joint compatibility and base reactions. It begins with Ring closure and hoop force and Invert curvature and force trajectory, links Closure distance and time effects and Groundwater uplift and drainage state, and ends with Permanent ring and maintenance handover. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 岩爆監測與卸壓支護
catalog.summary: 本課以用能量、變形與監測不確定度辨識岩爆支護需求為主線，從彈性能與釋放比例與拋出物動能與速度建立系統邊界，再把動態載入速率與試驗邊界、串聯力鏈與容量區分連到事件後剩餘行程與復核。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty. It begins with Elastic energy and releasable fraction and Ejected-rock energy and velocity, links Dynamic rate and test boundaries and Serial force paths and capacity distinctions, and ends with Post-event remaining stroke and requalification. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 擠壓性地層讓壓支護
catalog.summary: 本課以把擠壓地層收斂、讓壓行程與支護時序連成設計模型為主線，從應力強度比與初篩與收斂拘束與交會點建立系統邊界，再把收斂速率與時效、噴層間隙與局部壓碎連到觀察法與調整證據。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on link squeezing-ground convergence, yielding travel and support timing. It begins with Stress-strength ratio and screening and Convergence-confinement intersection, links Convergence rate and time dependence and Shotcrete slots and local crushing, and ends with Observational design and adjustment evidence. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 膨脹性地層隧道設計
catalog.summary: 本課以區分膨脹礦物、水源與受限變形的隧道設計為主線，從礦物反應與含水條件與自由膨脹與試體方向建立系統邊界，再把水源路徑與暴露量、仰拱拘束與接觸壓力連到長期維護與反應地圖。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish swelling minerals, water supply and restrained deformation in tunnel design. It begins with Mineral reactions and water conditions and Free swell and specimen direction, links Water pathways and exposure volume and Invert restraint and contact pressure, and ends with Long-term maintenance and reaction maps. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 高水壓隧道止水灌漿
catalog.summary: 本課以用水頭、壓力損失與滲流證據評估高水壓止水灌漿為主線，從水頭基準與孔隙水壓與泵表讀值與孔段壓力建立系統邊界，再把幾何體積與實際注入量、前後透水比較與水頭連到驗收範圍與長期水路。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on assess high-head water-control grouting using head, pressure loss and seepage evidence. It begins with Head datum and pore pressure and Pump gauge and interval pressure, links Geometric volume and delivered volume and Before-after permeability and head, and ends with Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 隧道湧水排導系統
catalog.summary: 本課以用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水為主線，從地下水與施工用水收支與支管流速與有效斷面建立系統邊界，再把集水容量與反應時間、堵塞敏感度與維護連到長期水文與維護交接。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy. It begins with Groundwater and process-water balance and Branch velocity and effective area, links Sump storage and response time and Blockage sensitivity and maintenance, and ends with Long-term hydrology and handover. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 既有隧道漏水修繕
catalog.summary: 本課以以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水為主線，從凝結與地下水來源與漏水量級與時間窗建立系統邊界，再把水頭正規化與成效、排水保留與壓力轉移連到修繕履歷與重複缺陷。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility. It begins with Condensation and groundwater sources and Leakage scale and time windows, links Head normalization and repair effect and Drainage preservation and pressure transfer, and ends with Repair history and recurrent defects. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 明挖覆蓋隧道施工
catalog.summary: 本課以整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段為主線，從開挖尺度與地表影響與側向土壓與變形條件建立系統邊界，再把箱體自重與施工抗浮、支撐拆換與荷載轉移連到地表恢復與地下資產交接。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels. It begins with Excavation scale and surface impact and Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions, links Box weight and temporary flotation and Brace removal and load transfer, and ends with Surface restoration and underground handover. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 逆打工法地下結構
catalog.summary: 本課以追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載為主線，從永久樓板的早期支撐與預置柱軸力與未支撐長度建立系統邊界，再把牆板接頭與剪力交接、地下水卸載與地層回彈連到施工歷程與永久文件。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls. It begins with Permanent slabs as early braces and Plunge-column force and unbraced length, links Wall-slab joints and shear transfer and Groundwater unloading and ground rebound, and ends with Construction history and permanent records. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 沉管隧道預製與浮運
catalog.summary: 本課以整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面為主線，從預製體積與結構質量與排水體積與浮力平衡建立系統邊界，再把吃水變化與水線面、預製溫度與節段變形連到浮運放行與資料一致性。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces. It begins with Fabrication volume and structural mass and Displacement and buoyancy balance, links Draft change and waterplane area and Fabrication temperature and segment deformation, and ends with Flotation release and record consistency. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 沉管基床整平
catalog.summary: 本課以以海床幾何、接觸壓力與沉陷驗證沉管基床為主線，從溝槽斷面與開挖體積與淨重與基床平均壓力建立系統邊界，再把墊層厚度與材料收支、高點接觸與局部壓力連到基床交接與長期基線。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on verify immersed-tunnel bedding through seabed geometry, contact pressure and settlement. It begins with Trench section and dredging volume and Submerged weight and mean bed pressure, links Bedding thickness and material balance and High-point contact and local pressure, and ends with Bedding handover and long-term baseline. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 沉管水下對接與止水
catalog.summary: 本課以沉管接頭幾何、壓縮接觸與雙重水密屏障為主線，從端面姿態與初始接觸與主密封壓縮與反力曲線建立系統邊界，再把溫度伸縮與軸向位移、剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心連到屏障獨立性與交接檔案。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on immersed-joint geometry, compression contact and dual sealing barriers. It begins with End-face attitude and initial contact and Primary-seal compression and reaction curves, links Thermal expansion and axial movement and Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact, and ends with Barrier independence and handover records. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 箱涵頂進施工
catalog.summary: 本課以箱涵頂進的力鏈、地層損失與營運界面為主線，從箱涵自重與滑移界面與油壓推力與後座反力建立系統邊界，再把刃口接觸與局部承壓、姿態修正與曲線相容連到封鎖窗口與恢復證據。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on box-jacking load paths, ground loss and operating interfaces. It begins with Box weight and sliding interfaces and Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force, links Cutting-edge contact and local bearing and Attitude correction and path compatibility, and ends with Possession windows and restoration evidence. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 微型隧道機頂管
catalog.summary: 本課以微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力為主線，從面壓合力與地下水邊界與泥漿濃度與固體平衡建立系統邊界，再把接頭傳力與墊材接觸、泥水管路損失與流變連到成品管線水密與紀錄。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading. It begins with Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary and Slurry concentration and solids balance, links Joint load transfer and packer contact and Slurry-line loss and rheology, and ends with Finished-pipeline tightness and records. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 頂管中繼推進站
catalog.summary: 本課以頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸為主線，從分段推力與反力連續與多缸合力與偏心檢核建立系統邊界，再把管列彈性壓縮與位移差、曲線管列與徑向作用連到站體閉合與通水淨空。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on intermediate-jacking segment forces, stroke compatibility and local contact. It begins with Segment thrust and reaction continuity and Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity, links Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences and Curved pipe strings and radial action, and ends with Station closure and hydraulic clearance. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 水平定向鑽掘導向
catalog.summary: 本課以定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距為主線，從鑽桿長度與垂向投影與方位誤差與橫向漂移建立系統邊界，再把磁場干擾與方位可信度、設施淨距與不確定度連到竣工閉合與全線可信度。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance. It begins with Rod length and vertical projection and Heading error and lateral drift, links Magnetic interference and heading confidence and Utility clearance and uncertainty, and ends with As-built closure and route confidence. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 豎井沉井施工
catalog.summary: 本課以沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮為主線，從下沉驅動與力系平衡與側摩阻與埋深累積建立系統邊界，再把井底滲流與有效應力、位移速率與突沉辨識連到永久抗浮與階段交接。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
catalog.summaryEn: This course focuses on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift. It begins with Sinking drive and force equilibrium and Skin resistance and embedded depth, links Base seepage and effective stress and Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection, and ends with Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

catalog.title: 深豎井襯砌施工
catalog.summary: 深豎井襯砌同時受到地層卸載、地下水、施工分段與長期材料變形影響。本課從有效應力及環向受壓開始，逐步區分厚壁分析、垂直承載、止水細部及背填空隙造成的彎曲，最後建立水位回復與裂縫變化的交接證據。
catalog.summaryEn: Deep-shaft linings respond to ground unloading, groundwater, construction lifts and long-term material deformation. The course separates effective stress and ring compression from thick-wall analysis, vertical load transfer, waterstop behaviour and bending over backfill voids, then builds evidence for groundwater recovery and crack monitoring.

catalog.title: 大直徑鑽掘豎井
catalog.summary: 大直徑豎井的進度由完整作業循環決定，不能只看切削機額定功率。本課把幾何開挖量、切削能、提升循環、工作盤反力與通風排水聯成系統，利用量測分辨設備瓶頸與地層限制，並以故障停機及永久襯砌介面建立可追溯的施工交接。
catalog.summaryEn: Large-shaft progress depends on the complete operating cycle rather than rated cutting power. The course links excavation volume, cutting energy, hoisting cycles, working-platform reactions, ventilation and drainage, uses measurements to separate equipment bottlenecks from ground constraints, and develops traceable handover through downtime and permanent-lining interfaces.

catalog.title: 地下岩洞穹頂支護
catalog.summary: 大跨度岩洞的穩定同時受到節理幾何、開挖卸載、支護剛度及三維交叉口影響。本課分開討論可脫落楔塊與整體岩體拱效應，讓學徒用力學模型、應變監測及反算辨別真正的荷載路徑，再檢查地震與排水退化如何改變既有支護的需求。
catalog.summaryEn: Large-span cavern stability depends on joints, excavation unloading, support stiffness and three-dimensional intersections. This course distinguishes detachable wedges from rock-mass arching, uses force models, strain monitoring and back-analysis to identify load paths, and evaluates how seismic action and drainage deterioration change support demand.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制

catalog.title: 交叉隧道人工地盤凍結
catalog.summary: 人工地盤凍結透過冷卻與相變暫時增加地層強度並減少滲流，卻同時引入熱量、凍脹及解凍變形問題。本課將凍結管幾何、對流熱輸送、長期潛變與備援冷量分開檢查，再建立從臨時凍土支護轉交永久襯砌的證據與停留點。
catalog.summaryEn: Artificial ground freezing temporarily strengthens ground and restricts seepage through cooling and phase change, while introducing thermal, heave and thaw-deformation concerns. The course separately examines pipe geometry, advective heat, creep and cooling reserves, then builds evidence and hold points for transferring support from frozen soil to the permanent lining.

catalog.title: 連續壁槽溝穩定
catalog.summary: 連續壁成槽時，穩定液必須與地下水、土層滲透性及地面載重共同維持槽壁穩定。本課從壓差與濾餅機理出發，連結槽段幾何、垂直度、沉渣與鋼筋籠浮力，再用混凝土量平衡與接頭水力坡降建立施工品質及鄰房變形的驗證鏈。
catalog.summaryEn: During diaphragm-wall excavation, support fluid interacts with groundwater, permeability and surface loading to maintain trench stability. The course connects pressure balance and filter cake to panel geometry, verticality, sediment and cage buoyancy, then uses concrete-volume balance and joint hydraulic gradients to verify construction quality and adjacent-asset movement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制

catalog.title: 咬合樁止水壁施工
catalog.summary: 咬合樁牆以相鄰樁體互相切入形成連續擋土與止水系統，其性能受樁位、垂直度、切削時齡及結構樁剛度共同控制。本課將幾何咬合與材料強度分開驗證，再檢查冠梁傳力、嵌入深度、缺口滲流與長期裂縫，建立全深度的竣工證據。
catalog.summaryEn: Secant walls use overlapping piles to form a retaining and cutoff system governed by position, verticality, cutting age and structural-pile stiffness. The course verifies geometric overlap separately from material strength, then examines capping-beam transfer, embedment, defect seepage and long-term cracking through full-depth as-built evidence.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制

catalog.title: 鋼板樁圍堰支撐
catalog.summary: 鋼板樁圍堰的安全取決於水土壓、支撐系統、鎖口止水與開挖底部的滲流穩定。本課以逐階段自由體圖連結抽水、支撐預力、樁趾被動反力及拆撐，並檢查角隅扭矩、水流拖曳與材料劣化，避免只用單根板樁彎矩代表整個圍堰。
catalog.summaryEn: Sheet-pile cofferdams depend on water and earth pressures, bracing, interlock sealing and base seepage stability. Stage-specific free bodies connect dewatering, support force, toe resistance and removal, with checks of corner torsion, current drag and deterioration beyond the bending demand of one sheet pile.

catalog.title: 深開挖內支撐預壓
catalog.summary: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。
catalog.summaryEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines.

catalog.title: 地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證
catalog.titleEn: Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths
catalog.summary: 地錨試驗的位移同時包含自由段伸長、錨碇段變形與座頭滑移，不能由單一荷重或總位移推定錨固品質。本課把穩定錨碇區、拉力分量、潛變、腐蝕與群體作用逐一拆開，最後以座入損失及完整試驗證據確認地錨的長期功能。
catalog.summaryEn: Anchor-test movement combines free-length extension, bond-zone deformation and head slip, so one load or displacement does not establish anchorage quality. The course separates stable anchorage, force components, creep, corrosion and group action, then uses seating losses and complete test evidence to assess long-term anchor function.

catalog.title: 微型樁托底補強
catalog.summary: 微型樁托底的關鍵不只是把樁打到深處，而是建立既有柱、承台、連接件與地層之間可驗證的新力流。本課逐步檢查鋼材與黏結承載、預載移交、樁群剛度、無側限段挫屈與低淨高接頭，最後用長期沉陷判讀新舊基礎是否確實共同工作。
catalog.summaryEn: Micropile underpinning requires a verified new load path from existing columns through caps and connectors into ground. The course examines steel and bond resistance, preloaded transfer, group stiffness, buckling in unsupported zones and low-headroom joints, then interprets long-term settlement to establish interaction between old and new foundations.

catalog.title: 噴射灌漿地盤改良
catalog.summary: 噴射灌漿以高能流體侵蝕並混合原土，形成幾何與材料性質受地層控制的改良體。本課區分止水與承載需求，從滲流、咬合、材料留存及返漿量平衡出發，逐步檢查強度發展、複合地盤分力、鑽孔偏斜和統計變異，最後以水力試驗驗證整體功能。
catalog.summaryEn: Jet grouting erodes and mixes soil to form treated bodies whose geometry and properties depend on ground conditions. The course separates cutoff and bearing functions, linking seepage, overlap, binder retention and return balance to strength, composite-ground sharing, bore deviation and variability, then verifies overall performance hydraulically.

catalog.title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良
catalog.summary: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。
catalog.summaryEn: Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance.

catalog.title: 補償灌漿沉陷控制
catalog.summary: 補償灌漿透過受控的地層變形降低隧道施工對資產的沉陷影響，其目標是控制差異變形而非追求最大抬升。本課把沉陷槽、注入效率、孔位誤差、有效應力及回饋延遲連成模型，再檢查結構角變形、曲率與停止注入後的殘餘反應。
catalog.summaryEn: Compensation grouting controls ground deformation to reduce settlement effects from tunnelling, targeting differential movement rather than maximum heave. The course connects settlement troughs, injection efficiency, bore position, effective stress and feedback delay, then evaluates structural distortion, curvature and residual movement after injection stops.

catalog.title: 地盤壓密灌漿
catalog.summary: 壓密灌漿主要藉低流動性漿團擠移周圍土體，適用性與排水、密實狀態及可容許位移密切相關。本課區分擠密、填空與劈裂，從孔壓、孔隙比、漿泡幾何及處理覆蓋出發，連結等待時間、地表隆起、資產推力與改善後的剩餘沉陷。
catalog.summaryEn: Compaction grouting displaces surrounding soil with low-mobility grout masses, with suitability governed by drainage, density and tolerable movement. The course distinguishes densification, void filling and fracture, connecting pore pressure, void ratio, bulb geometry and coverage to waiting time, heave, asset force and residual settlement.

catalog.title: 砂井與垂直排水板

catalog.summaryEn: Sand drains and prefabricated drains shorten drainage paths and accelerate excess-pressure dissipation without eliminating compressibility. The course connects grid geometry, equivalent diameter, radial time and installation smear to well resistance, loading, settlement and drain deterioration, establishing unloading and handover criteria from both pressure and movement.

a114.note: 毛細填膠的流動前緣可能包住空氣。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a114.noteEn: An underfill flow front can trap air. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a115.note: 模封後曲率反映材料與固化歷史。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a115.noteEn: Post-mold curvature depends on material and cure history. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a119.note: 嵌入晶粒的接觸開口與樹脂層要可追溯。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a119.noteEn: Trace contact openings and resin layers in embedded die. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a126.note: 有機中介層的材料各向異性不可忽略。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a126.noteEn: Organic-interposer anisotropy matters. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a127.note: 玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。此 BGA 截面僅示意接點與基板位置，不能確認其核心材料是玻璃。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a127.noteEn: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification. This BGA section locates joints and substrate but does not establish a glass-core material. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a128.note: ABF 增層依賴介電層及微孔的連續品質。此 BGA 截面不能辨識樹脂化學成分，也不能確認使用 ABF 材料。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a128.noteEn: ABF build-up depends on dielectric and microvia quality. This BGA section does not identify resin chemistry or establish the use of ABF. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a133.note: 封裝供電完整性包含頻率相關阻抗。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a133.noteEn: Package power integrity involves frequency-dependent impedance. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a134.note: 訊號完整性包含串音與返回電流。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a134.noteEn: Signal integrity includes crosstalk and return current. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a136.note: 寄生參數與激發頻率及參考平面有關。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a136.noteEn: Parasitics depend on frequency and reference planes. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a137.note: 去耦電容的 ESL 與放置路徑影響有效性。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a137.noteEn: ESL and placement paths limit decoupling effectiveness. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a146.note: 溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a146.noteEn: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a147.note: 吸濕量與回焊中的內部壓力是不同觀察。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a147.noteEn: Moisture uptake and reflow-induced pressure are different observations. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a149.note: 聲學回波受界面與閘門深度影響。此為實體 BGA 截面的光學照片，不是超音波 A-scan 或 C-scan 檢測資料。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a149.noteEn: Acoustic echoes depend on interfaces and gate depth. This optical photograph of a physical BGA section is not ultrasonic A-scan or C-scan data. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a006.noteEn: Use the wafer to orient substrate scale. This surface photograph cannot identify SOI or reveal a buried oxide; use the course cross-section for the layer structure.

a016.note: 晶圓是雷射退火的處理對象；本照片沒有雷射設備、溫度分布或摻雜活化資料，不能由顏色判定退火結果。

a024.note: 以完整晶圓對照課內 CFET 奈米截面的尺度差距；照片不是 imec 的 CFET 樣品，也不能辨認上下互補電晶體。
a024.noteEn: Compare wafer scale with the course CFET nanoscale cross-section. This is not an imec CFET sample and does not reveal stacked complementary transistors.

a027.note: 晶圓表面提供製造尺度的起點；照片沒有可驗證的技術節點資訊，不可標成次二奈米製程實拍。
a027.noteEn: The wafer surface introduces manufacturing scale. No verifiable node information is available for this image; it is not a photograph of a sub-2-nm process.

a038.note: 由晶圓上重複晶粒辨認圖案複製的尺度；OPC 修正形狀遠小於照片解析度，本圖不能驗證 OPC 成敗。
a038.noteEn: Repeated die patterns introduce the scale of pattern replication. OPC corrections are far below this photograph’s resolution; this image cannot validate OPC.

a039.note: 晶圓是成像圖案最終轉移的載體；照片沒有光罩、反向微影目標函數或模擬空中影像。請搭配本課計算流程圖。
a039.noteEn: The wafer is the substrate onto which imaging patterns are transferred. No mask, inverse-lithography objective function or simulated aerial image is pictured; use the course computation diagram.

a047.note: 晶圓照片提供電子束寫入載體的尺度背景；沒有顯示電子束柱、曝光光阻或寫入解析度。
a047.noteEn: The wafer photograph provides substrate-scale context for electron-beam writing. It does not show an electron column, exposed resist or writing resolution.

a067.note: 晶圓表面外觀作為平坦化與後續圖案製作的背景；這不是 CMP 加工中照片，光亮外觀也不能代替平坦度量測。
a067.noteEn: The wafer surface provides context for planarization and subsequent patterning. CMP is not in progress, and a reflective appearance cannot replace flatness measurement.

a068.note: 以晶圓作為漿料與磨粒作用的基板背景；照片看不到磨粒粒徑、分散性、化學組成或 CMP 去除率。
a068.noteEn: The wafer provides substrate context for slurry and abrasive action. The image reveals no abrasive size, dispersion, chemistry or CMP removal rate.

a106.note: 整片接合要同時管理局部對準及全域形變。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a106.noteEn: Whole-wafer bonding combines local alignment and global deformation. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a109.note: 暫時膠層提供機械支撐但必須能移除。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a109.noteEn: A temporary adhesive supports a wafer but must be removable. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a110.note: 背磨厚度與次表面損傷要分開管理。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a110.noteEn: Control remaining thickness separately from subsurface damage. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a111.note: 隱形切割的改質層在晶片內部。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a111.noteEn: Stealth dicing modifies material inside the wafer. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a117.note: 面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。晶圓照片只供圓形基材與尺度比較，不是面板級封裝製程的實拍。 辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a117.noteEn: Panel deformation is not automatically corrected by wafer models. The wafer photo provides circular-substrate/scale context, not footage of panel-level packaging. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a123.note: 背面露出有矽殘留與過度去除兩種風險。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a123.noteEn: Backside reveal risks both silicon residue and over-removal. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.
